ko.title: 2027년 직장인 건강 보험: 오픈 인롤먼트(Open Enrollment) 기간에 보험료와 공제액이 더 높아지는 이유

segments.src: As open enrollment season begins at many workplaces, a familiar pattern is showing up in benefits packets: the cost of coverage is rising, and more of that cost is landing on employees.
segments.tr: 많은 직장에서 오픈 인롤먼트(가입 신청) 시즌이 시작되면서, 혜택 안내문에서 익숙한 패턴이 나타나고 있습니다. 바로 보장 비용은 상승하고, 그 비용 중 더 많은 부분이 직원에게 전가되고 있다는 점입니다.

segments.src: Surveys from benefits consultants and industry groups have pointed to continued increases in medical and prescription drug spending, and many employers say they are adjusting plan designs to manage the bill.
segments.tr: 혜택 컨설턴트와 업계 그룹의 설문조사에 따르면 의료비 및 처방약 지출이 계속 증가하고 있으며, 많은 고용주가 비용 관리를 위해 플랜 설계를 조정하고 있다고 답했습니다.

segments.src: This guide explains why premiums and deductibles tend to climb, what to compare when you review your options for 2027, and how to avoid common mistakes before your enrollment window closes.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 보험료와 공제액이 왜 계속 오르는 경향이 있는지, 2027년 옵션을 검토할 때 무엇을 비교해야 하는지, 그리고 가입 기간이 종료되기 전에 흔히 저지르는 실수를 피하는 방법을 설명합니다.

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is for general information only. It is not medical, tax, legal, or financial advice. Plan details vary widely, so always check your own employer's official materials.
segments.tr: > **참고:** 이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 합니다. 의료, 세무, 법률 또는 재정적 조언이 아닙니다. 플랜 세부 사항은 매우 다양하므로 항상 본인 고용주의 공식 자료를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: ## Why Costs Keep Rising
segments.tr: ## 비용이 계속 상승하는 이유

segments.src: Several forces tend to push employer plan costs up at the same time:
segments.tr: 여러 요인이 동시에 작용하여 고용주 플랜 비용을 상승시키는 경향이 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Higher medical prices and use of care.** Hospital and provider costs, along with greater use of services, can raise what a plan pays out.
segments.tr: - **의료 가격 상승 및 의료 서비스 이용 증가.** 병원 및 의료 제공자 비용과 서비스 이용 증가로 인해 플랜이 지불해야 하는 금액이 늘어날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Prescription drug spending.** Specialty medications and newer, high-cost therapies are a growing share of claims for many plans.
segments.tr: - **처방약 지출.** 전문 의약품과 더 새롭고 고가의 치료법이 많은 플랜의 청구액에서 차지하는 비중이 커지고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Plan renewals and insurer pricing.** Insurers and stop-loss carriers reset rates each year, and employers that self-fund their plans carry the risk of large claims directly.
segments.tr: - **플랜 갱신 및 보험사의 가격 책정.** 보험사와 손실 보전(stop-loss) 보험사는 매년 요율을 재설정하며, 자체적으로 플랜 자금을 조달하는 고용주는 거액의 청구 위험을 직접 부담합니다.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing shifts.** To hold down their own spending, employers may raise employee premium contributions, deductibles, copays, or out-of-pocket maximums, or they may narrow provider networks.
segments.tr: - **비용 분담의 변화.** 고용주는 자체 지출을 억제하기 위해 직원의 보험료 분담금, 공제액, 공동 부담금(copay), 또는 본인 부담 최대액을 인상하거나 의료 네트워크를 축소할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The result is that a plan that looked familiar last year may cost more or work differently this year, even if the plan name has not changed.
segments.tr: 그 결과, 작년에 익숙했던 플랜이라도 플랜 이름이 바뀌지 않았더라도 올해는 비용이 더 많이 들거나 작동 방식이 다를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What Changes You May See
segments.tr: ## 예상되는 변화

segments.src: Not every employer makes the same moves, but common adjustments include:
segments.tr: 모든 고용주가 동일한 조치를 취하는 것은 아니지만, 일반적인 조정 사항은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Higher payroll deductions.** Your per-paycheck premium may rise, and the increase is often larger for family coverage.
segments.tr: 1. **급여 공제액 인상.** 급여에서 공제되는 보험료가 오를 수 있으며, 가족 보장의 경우 인상폭이 더 큰 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Bigger deductibles.** You may have to pay more out of pocket before the plan starts sharing costs.
segments.tr: 2. **공제액(Deductible) 인상.** 플랜이 비용을 분담하기 시작하기 전에 본인이 부담해야 하는 금액이 더 커질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Higher out-of-pocket maximums.** This is the most you could pay in a plan year for covered, in-network care.
segments.tr: 3. **본인 부담 최대액(Out-of-pocket maximum) 인상.** 이는 플랜 연도 동안 네트워크 내 보장된 진료에 대해 지불할 수 있는 최대 금액입니다.

segments.src: 4. **Changes to drug coverage.** Look for tier changes, new prior-authorization rules, or different copays and coinsurance.
segments.tr: 4. **약물 보장 변경.** 등급 변경, 새로운 사전 승인 규칙, 또는 다른 공동 부담금 및 공동 보험료(coinsurance)를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: 5. **Network changes.** A doctor or hospital you use may move in or out of the network.
segments.tr: 5. **네트워크 변경.** 이용 중인 의사나 병원이 네트워크에 포함되거나 제외될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 6. **Fewer plan choices.** Some employers consolidate options or steer people toward high-deductible plans.
segments.tr: 6. **플랜 선택권 축소.** 일부 고용주는 옵션을 통합하거나 고공제 플랜으로 유도하기도 합니다.

segments.src: ## What to Compare Side by Side
segments.tr: ## 나란히 비교해야 할 항목

segments.src: Do not judge a plan by the premium alone.
segments.tr: 보험료만 보고 플랜을 판단하지 마십시오.

segments.src: Build a simple comparison for each option:
segments.tr: 각 옵션에 대해 간단한 비교표를 만드십시오:

segments.src: | What to check | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | 확인 항목 | 중요한 이유 |

segments.src: | Per-paycheck premium | Your guaranteed yearly cost, whether or not you use care |
segments.tr: | 급여 공제 보험료 | 의료 서비스를 이용하든 안 하든 보장되는 연간 비용 |

segments.src: | Deductible (individual and family) | What you pay before most cost-sharing begins |
segments.tr: | 공제액 (개인 및 가족) | 대부분의 비용 분담이 시작되기 전에 본인이 지불하는 금액 |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case spending for covered in-network care |
segments.tr: | 본인 부담 최대액 | 네트워크 내 보장 진료에 대한 최악의 경우 지출액 |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | What you pay for visits, tests, and procedures |
segments.tr: | 공동 부담금 및 공동 보험료 | 진료, 검사, 시술에 대해 지불하는 금액 |

segments.src: | Prescription tiers | Whether your regular medications are covered and at what cost |
segments.tr: | 처방약 등급 | 정기적으로 복용하는 약이 보장되는지, 비용은 얼마인지 |

segments.src: | Network | Whether your doctors, specialists, and hospital are in-network |
segments.tr: | 네트워크 | 의사, 전문의, 병원이 네트워크 내에 있는지 |

segments.src: | Employer HSA or HRA contribution | Free money that can offset a higher deductible |
segments.tr: | 고용주의 HSA 또는 HRA 기여금 | 더 높은 공제액을 상쇄할 수 있는 무료 지원금 |

segments.src: A helpful exercise: estimate your total yearly cost for each plan in two scenarios.
segments.tr: 유용한 연습: 두 가지 시나리오에서 각 플랜의 총 연간 비용을 추정해보십시오.

segments.src: First, a **low-use year** (routine checkups and a few prescriptions).
segments.tr: 첫째, **의료 이용이 적은 해** (정기 검진 및 몇 가지 처방약).

segments.src: Second, a **high-use year** (a surgery, an emergency room visit, or a new ongoing treatment).
segments.tr: 둘째, **의료 이용이 많은 해** (수술, 응급실 방문, 또는 새로운 지속적 치료).

segments.src: Add the annual premiums to your likely out-of-pocket costs in each case.
segments.tr: 각 경우에 연간 보험료와 예상되는 본인 부담 비용을 더하십시오.

segments.src: The cheapest premium is not always the cheapest plan overall.
segments.tr: 보험료가 가장 저렴하다고 해서 전체적으로 가장 저렴한 플랜은 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Understanding High-Deductible Plans and HSAs
segments.tr: ## 고공제 플랜(HDHP)과 HSA 이해하기

segments.src: Many employers are expanding high-deductible health plans (HDHPs).
segments.tr: 많은 고용주가 고공제 건강 플랜(HDHP)을 확대하고 있습니다.

segments.src: These typically have lower premiums but higher deductibles.
segments.tr: 이 플랜은 일반적으로 보험료는 낮지만 공제액은 높습니다.

segments.src: If you are enrolled in a qualifying HDHP, you may be eligible to contribute to a **health savings account (HSA)**.
segments.tr: 자격을 갖춘 HDHP에 가입하면 **건강 저축 계좌(HSA)**에 기여할 자격이 생길 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Key HSA features to know:
segments.tr: 알아두어야 할 주요 HSA 특징:

segments.src: - **Tax advantages.** Contributions are generally pre-tax or tax-deductible, growth is tax-free, and withdrawals for qualified medical expenses are tax-free. Review current IRS rules for details.
segments.tr: - **세금 혜택.** 기여금은 일반적으로 세전 또는 소득 공제가 가능하며, 증식분은 비과세이고, 적격 의료비로 인출할 경우 비과세입니다. 자세한 내용은 현재 IRS 규정을 검토하십시오.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits that adjust over time, with higher limits for family coverage and a catch-up amount for people age 55 and older. Check the IRS figures for 2027 before you set your contribution.
segments.tr: - **기여 한도.** IRS는 시간이 지남에 따라 조정되는 연간 한도를 설정하며, 가족 보장에 대해서는 더 높은 한도를, 55세 이상인 사람에게는 추가 납입액을 허용합니다. 기여금을 설정하기 전에 2027년 IRS 수치를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: - **Portability.** The money is yours and stays with you if you change jobs.
segments.tr: - **휴대성.** 이 돈은 본인 소유이며 직장을 옮겨도 그대로 유지됩니다.

segments.src: - **Employer contributions.** Some employers add money to your HSA. This can meaningfully reduce the sting of a higher deductible, so compare it carefully.
segments.tr: - **고용주 기여금.** 일부 고용주는 HSA에 돈을 추가해 줍니다. 이는 더 높은 공제액의 부담을 크게 줄여줄 수 있으므로 신중하게 비교하십시오.

segments.src: - **Eligibility limits.** Having certain other coverage, such as some general-purpose flexible spending accounts or other health coverage, can affect your eligibility. Read the plan rules.
segments.tr: - **자격 제한.** 특정 일반 목적의 유연 지출 계좌(FSA)나 다른 건강 보험 등 특정 다른 보장을 가지고 있으면 자격에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다. 플랜 규정을 읽어보십시오.

segments.src: An HDHP with an HSA can work well for people who are generally healthy and can afford to fund the account.
segments.tr: HSA가 포함된 HDHP는 일반적으로 건강하고 계좌에 자금을 조달할 여력이 있는 사람들에게 잘 맞을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: It can be harder for people who expect frequent care and may struggle to cover a large deductible up front.
segments.tr: 잦은 진료가 예상되고 큰 공제액을 미리 부담하기 어려운 사람들에게는 더 힘들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Other Accounts and Benefits Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## 살펴볼 가치가 있는 다른 계좌 및 혜택

segments.src: - **Flexible spending accounts (FSAs).** Health FSAs let you set aside pre-tax money, but they usually have "use it or lose it" limits with specific deadlines. Check how much can be carried over.
segments.tr: - **유연 지출 계좌(FSA).** 건강 FSA를 사용하면 세전 금액을 따로 적립할 수 있지만, 일반적으로 특정 기한이 있는 "사용하지 않으면 소멸(use it or lose it)" 제한이 있습니다. 얼마까지 이월할 수 있는지 확인하십시오.

segments.src: - **Dependent care FSAs.** These can help with eligible child or adult care costs.
segments.tr: - **부양가족 돌봄 FSA.** 적격 아동 또는 성인 돌봄 비용을 지원받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Telehealth and virtual care.** Some plans offer low-cost or free virtual visits that can reduce out-of-pocket spending for minor issues.
segments.tr: - **원격 의료 및 가상 진료.** 일부 플랜은 경미한 문제에 대해 본인 부담금을 줄일 수 있는 저렴하거나 무료인 가상 진료를 제공합니다.

segments.src: - **Mental health coverage.** Compare copays, visit limits, and whether therapists you use are in-network.
segments.tr: - **정신 건강 보장.** 공동 부담금, 방문 횟수 제한, 이용하는 치료사가 네트워크 내에 있는지 비교하십시오.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent rules.** Some employers add surcharges when a spouse has access to coverage elsewhere. Look for new surcharges or eligibility changes.
segments.tr: - **배우자 및 부양가족 규정.** 일부 고용주는 배우자가 다른 곳에서 보장을 받을 수 있는 경우 추가 요금을 부과합니다. 새로운 추가 요금이나 자격 변경 사항을 확인하십시오.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## 마감 전 실질적인 단계

segments.src: 1. **Mark the dates.** Open enrollment windows are short, and missing one can lock you into your current choices for a year, outside of qualifying life events.
segments.tr: 1. **날짜 표시.** 오픈 인롤먼트 기간은 짧으며, 놓치면 적격한 인생의 사건(qualifying life events)이 없는 한 1년 동안 현재 선택한 플랜에 묶일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Read the summary of benefits and coverage.** Employers must provide standardized summaries that make plans easier to compare.
segments.tr: 2. **혜택 및 보장 요약 읽기.** 고용주는 플랜을 쉽게 비교할 수 있도록 표준화된 요약본을 제공해야 합니다.

segments.src: 3. **Check your doctors and prescriptions.** Use the plan's provider directory and drug list, and confirm with your providers' offices when possible.
segments.tr: 3. **의사 및 처방약 확인.** 플랜의 의료 제공자 디렉토리와 약물 목록을 사용하고, 가능하면 의료 제공자 사무실에 확인하십시오.

segments.src: 4. **Review last year's spending.** Your past claims and explanation-of-benefits statements are a useful guide to what you may need.
segments.tr: 4. **작년 지출 검토.** 과거 청구 내역과 혜택 설명(EOB) 명세서는 필요한 보장이 무엇인지 파악하는 데 유용한 가이드가 됩니다.

segments.src: 5. **Look at the whole picture.** Consider premiums, deductibles, HSA or FSA options, and employer contributions together.
segments.tr: 5. **전체적인 그림 보기.** 보험료, 공제액, HSA 또는 FSA 옵션, 고용주 기여금을 함께 고려하십시오.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help.** Your HR or benefits team, plan portal, or benefits hotline can answer questions about the specifics.
segments.tr: 6. **도움 요청.** 인사팀이나 혜택 담당 팀, 플랜 포털, 또는 혜택 핫라인을 통해 세부 사항에 대한 질문을 해결하십시오.

segments.src: 7. **Think about alternatives.** If you have access to a spouse's plan or are eligible for other coverage, compare it with your own employer's options. Marketplace coverage may be an option in some situations, so review eligibility rules.
segments.tr: 7. **대안 고려.** 배우자의 플랜을 이용할 수 있거나 다른 보장을 받을 자격이 있다면, 본인 고용주의 옵션과 비교해보십시오. 상황에 따라 마켓플레이스 보장이 옵션이 될 수 있으므로 자격 규정을 검토하십시오.

segments.src: 8. **Confirm your choices.** Save your confirmation and review your first paycheck to make sure the deductions match what you selected.
segments.tr: 8. **선택 확인.** 확인서를 저장하고 첫 급여 명세서를 검토하여 공제액이 선택한 내용과 일치하는지 확인하십시오.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Rising health care and drug costs are shaping the benefits offered at many workplaces, and employees are often asked to cover more of the expense through premiums and deductibles.
segments.tr: 상승하는 의료비와 약값은 많은 직장에서 제공하는 혜택의 형태를 바꾸고 있으며, 직원들은 종종 보험료와 공제액을 통해 비용의 더 많은 부분을 부담하도록 요구받고 있습니다.

segments.src: The best response is to compare plans on total expected cost and fit with your health needs, not just the monthly premium.

zh.title: 2027年雇主健康计划：为什么开放注册通常意味着更高的保费和更高的免赔额

segments.src: As open enrollment season begins at many workplaces, a familiar pattern is showing up in benefits packets: the cost of coverage is rising, and more of that cost is landing on employees.
segments.tr: 随着许多工作场所开放注册季的开始，福利方案中出现了一个熟悉的模式：保险成本正在上升，而且更多的成本正由员工承担。

segments.src: Surveys from benefits consultants and industry groups have pointed to continued increases in medical and prescription drug spending, and many employers say they are adjusting plan designs to manage the bill.
segments.tr: 来自福利顾问和行业团体的调查指出，医疗和处方药支出持续增加，许多雇主表示他们正在调整计划设计以控制账单。

segments.src: This guide explains why premiums and deductibles tend to climb, what to compare when you review your options for 2027, and how to avoid common mistakes before your enrollment window closes.
segments.tr: 本指南解释了为什么保费和免赔额往往会攀升，在审查2027年选项时应该比较什么，以及如何在注册窗口关闭前避免常见错误。

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is for general information only. It is not medical, tax, legal, or financial advice. Plan details vary widely, so always check your own employer's official materials.
segments.tr: > **注意：** 本文仅供一般信息参考。它不构成医疗、税务、法律或财务建议。计划详情差异很大，因此请务必查看您雇主提供的官方材料。

segments.src: ## Why Costs Keep Rising
segments.tr: ## 为什么成本持续上升

segments.src: Several forces tend to push employer plan costs up at the same time:
segments.tr: 几种力量往往同时推高雇主计划的成本：

segments.src: - **Higher medical prices and use of care.** Hospital and provider costs, along with greater use of services, can raise what a plan pays out.
segments.tr: - **更高的医疗价格和护理使用率。** 医院和医疗服务提供者的成本，加上对服务使用量的增加，可能会提高计划的支出。

segments.src: - **Prescription drug spending.** Specialty medications and newer, high-cost therapies are a growing share of claims for many plans.
segments.tr: - **处方药支出。** 特种药物和更新、更高成本的疗法在许多计划的索赔中所占比例越来越大。

segments.src: - **Plan renewals and insurer pricing.** Insurers and stop-loss carriers reset rates each year, and employers that self-fund their plans carry the risk of large claims directly.
segments.tr: - **计划续保和保险公司定价。** 保险公司和止损承保人每年都会重置费率，而自行出资的雇主则直接承担巨额索赔的风险。

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing shifts.** To hold down their own spending, employers may raise employee premium contributions, deductibles, copays, or out-of-pocket maximums, or they may narrow provider networks.
segments.tr: - **成本分摊的转变。** 为了控制自己的支出，雇主可能会提高员工的保费分摊额、免赔额、共付额或自付最高限额，或者他们可能会缩小医疗服务网络。

segments.src: The result is that a plan that looked familiar last year may cost more or work differently this year, even if the plan name has not changed.
segments.tr: 结果是，即使计划名称没有改变，去年看起来熟悉的计划今年可能成本更高或运作方式不同。

segments.src: ## What Changes You May See
segments.tr: ## 您可能会看到的变动

segments.src: Not every employer makes the same moves, but common adjustments include:
segments.tr: 并非每个雇主都会采取相同的举措，但常见的调整包括：

segments.src: 1. **Higher payroll deductions.** Your per-paycheck premium may rise, and the increase is often larger for family coverage.
segments.tr: 1. **更高的工资扣除额。** 您每张工资单上的保费可能会上涨，而且家庭保险的涨幅通常更大。

segments.src: 2. **Bigger deductibles.** You may have to pay more out of pocket before the plan starts sharing costs.
segments.tr: 2. **更高的免赔额。** 在计划开始分摊费用之前，您可能需要支付更多的自付费用。

segments.src: 3. **Higher out-of-pocket maximums.** This is the most you could pay in a plan year for covered, in-network care.
segments.tr: 3. **更高的自付最高限额。** 这是您在一个计划年度内为承保的网络内护理可能支付的最高金额。

segments.src: 4. **Changes to drug coverage.** Look for tier changes, new prior-authorization rules, or different copays and coinsurance.
segments.tr: 4. **药物承保范围的变动。** 请留意分层变动、新的预先授权规则，或不同的共付额和共同保险。

segments.src: 5. **Network changes.** A doctor or hospital you use may move in or out of the network.
segments.tr: 5. **网络变动。** 您使用的医生或医院可能会进入或退出网络。

segments.src: 6. **Fewer plan choices.** Some employers consolidate options or steer people toward high-deductible plans.
segments.tr: 6. **更少的计划选择。** 一些雇主会整合选项或引导员工选择高免赔额计划。

segments.src: ## What to Compare Side by Side
segments.tr: ## 如何进行并排比较

segments.src: Do not judge a plan by the premium alone.
segments.tr: 不要仅凭保费来判断一个计划。

segments.src: Build a simple comparison for each option:
segments.tr: 为每个选项建立一个简单的比较：

segments.src: | What to check | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | 检查项目 | 重要性原因 |

segments.src: | Per-paycheck premium | Your guaranteed yearly cost, whether or not you use care |
segments.tr: | 每期工资保费 | 您保证的年度成本，无论您是否使用护理 |

segments.src: | Deductible (individual and family) | What you pay before most cost-sharing begins |
segments.tr: | 免赔额（个人和家庭） | 在大多数成本分摊开始前您支付的金额 |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case spending for covered in-network care |
segments.tr: | 自付最高限额 | 您为承保的网络内护理可能支付的最坏情况支出 |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | What you pay for visits, tests, and procedures |
segments.tr: | 共付额和共同保险 | 您为就诊、检查和手术支付的费用 |

segments.src: | Prescription tiers | Whether your regular medications are covered and at what cost |
segments.tr: | 处方药分层 | 您的常用药物是否在承保范围内以及成本如何 |

segments.src: | Network | Whether your doctors, specialists, and hospital are in-network |
segments.tr: | 网络 | 您的医生、专科医生和医院是否在网络内 |

segments.src: | Employer HSA or HRA contribution | Free money that can offset a higher deductible |
segments.tr: | 雇主HSA或HRA缴款 | 可以抵消更高免赔额的免费资金 |

segments.src: A helpful exercise: estimate your total yearly cost for each plan in two scenarios.
segments.tr: 一个有用的练习：在两种情况下估算每个计划的总年度成本。

segments.src: First, a **low-use year** (routine checkups and a few prescriptions).
segments.tr: 首先，**低使用率年份**（常规检查和少量处方药）。

segments.src: Second, a **high-use year** (a surgery, an emergency room visit, or a new ongoing treatment).
segments.tr: 其次，**高使用率年份**（手术、急诊室就诊或新的持续治疗）。

segments.src: Add the annual premiums to your likely out-of-pocket costs in each case.
segments.tr: 将年度保费加到每种情况下您可能的自付费用中。

segments.src: The cheapest premium is not always the cheapest plan overall.
segments.tr: 最便宜的保费并不总是总成本最低的计划。

segments.src: ## Understanding High-Deductible Plans and HSAs
segments.tr: ## 了解高免赔额计划和HSA

segments.src: Many employers are expanding high-deductible health plans (HDHPs).
segments.tr: 许多雇主正在扩大高免赔额健康计划（HDHP）。

segments.src: These typically have lower premiums but higher deductibles.
segments.tr: 这些计划通常保费较低，但免赔额较高。

segments.src: If you are enrolled in a qualifying HDHP, you may be eligible to contribute to a **health savings account (HSA)**.
segments.tr: 如果您参加了符合条件的HDHP，您可能有资格向**健康储蓄账户（HSA）**缴款。

segments.src: Key HSA features to know:
segments.tr: 需要了解的关键HSA特征：

segments.src: - **Tax advantages.** Contributions are generally pre-tax or tax-deductible, growth is tax-free, and withdrawals for qualified medical expenses are tax-free. Review current IRS rules for details.
segments.tr: - **税务优势。** 缴款通常是税前或可抵扣税款的，增长是免税的，且用于合格医疗费用的取款也是免税的。请查看当前的IRS规则以了解详情。

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits that adjust over time, with higher limits for family coverage and a catch-up amount for people age 55 and older. Check the IRS figures for 2027 before you set your contribution.
segments.tr: - **缴款限额。** IRS设定了随时间调整的年度限额，家庭保险有更高的限额，55岁及以上的人群有补缴金额。在设定缴款额之前，请查看2027年的IRS数据。

segments.src: - **Portability.** The money is yours and stays with you if you change jobs.
segments.tr: - **可携带性。** 这笔钱属于您，如果您换工作，它会随您一起转移。

segments.src: - **Employer contributions.** Some employers add money to your HSA. This can meaningfully reduce the sting of a higher deductible, so compare it carefully.
segments.tr: - **雇主缴款。** 一些雇主会向您的HSA存入资金。这可以显著减轻更高免赔额带来的痛苦，因此请仔细比较。

segments.src: - **Eligibility limits.** Having certain other coverage, such as some general-purpose flexible spending accounts or other health coverage, can affect your eligibility. Read the plan rules.
segments.tr: - **资格限制。** 拥有某些其他保险，例如某些通用目的的灵活支出账户或其他健康保险，可能会影响您的资格。请阅读计划规则。

segments.src: An HDHP with an HSA can work well for people who are generally healthy and can afford to fund the account.
segments.tr: 带有HSA的HDHP对于通常健康且有能力为账户注资的人来说效果很好。

segments.src: It can be harder for people who expect frequent care and may struggle to cover a large deductible up front.
segments.tr: 对于那些预期需要频繁护理且可能难以预先支付大额免赔额的人来说，这可能会更困难。

segments.src: ## Other Accounts and Benefits Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## 其他值得关注的账户和福利

segments.src: - **Flexible spending accounts (FSAs).** Health FSAs let you set aside pre-tax money, but they usually have "use it or lose it" limits with specific deadlines. Check how much can be carried over.
segments.tr: - **灵活支出账户（FSA）。** 健康FSA允许您留出税前资金，但它们通常有特定的截止日期的“不用就作废”限制。请检查可以结转多少金额。

segments.src: - **Dependent care FSAs.** These can help with eligible child or adult care costs.
segments.tr: - **受抚养人护理FSA。** 这些可以帮助支付符合条件的儿童或成人护理费用。

segments.src: - **Telehealth and virtual care.** Some plans offer low-cost or free virtual visits that can reduce out-of-pocket spending for minor issues.
segments.tr: - **远程医疗和虚拟护理。** 一些计划提供低成本或免费的虚拟就诊，可以减少小问题的自付支出。

segments.src: - **Mental health coverage.** Compare copays, visit limits, and whether therapists you use are in-network.
segments.tr: - **心理健康承保。** 比较共付额、就诊次数限制以及您使用的治疗师是否在网络内。

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent rules.** Some employers add surcharges when a spouse has access to coverage elsewhere. Look for new surcharges or eligibility changes.
segments.tr: - **配偶和受抚养人规则。** 一些雇主在配偶有其他保险途径时会增加附加费。请留意新的附加费或资格变动。

segments.src: ## Practical Steps Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## 截止日期前的实际步骤

segments.src: 1. **Mark the dates.** Open enrollment windows are short, and missing one can lock you into your current choices for a year, outside of qualifying life events.
segments.tr: 1. **标记日期。** 开放注册窗口很短，错过一次可能会让您在一年内被锁定在当前的选项中，除非发生符合条件的生活事件。

segments.src: 2. **Read the summary of benefits and coverage.** Employers must provide standardized summaries that make plans easier to compare.
segments.tr: 2. **阅读福利和承保摘要。** 雇主必须提供标准化的摘要，使计划更容易比较。

segments.src: 3. **Check your doctors and prescriptions.** Use the plan's provider directory and drug list, and confirm with your providers' offices when possible.
segments.tr: 3. **检查您的医生和处方药。** 使用计划的提供者目录和药物清单，并在可能的情况下与您的提供者办公室确认。

segments.src: 4. **Review last year's spending.** Your past claims and explanation-of-benefits statements are a useful guide to what you may need.
segments.tr: 4. **审查去年的支出。** 您过去的索赔和福利说明声明是您可能需要的有用指南。

segments.src: 5. **Look at the whole picture.** Consider premiums, deductibles, HSA or FSA options, and employer contributions together.
segments.tr: 5. **着眼全局。** 将保费、免赔额、HSA或FSA选项以及雇主缴款综合考虑。

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help.** Your HR or benefits team, plan portal, or benefits hotline can answer questions about the specifics.
segments.tr: 6. **寻求帮助。** 您的HR或福利团队、计划门户网站或福利热线可以回答有关具体细节的问题。

segments.src: 7. **Think about alternatives.** If you have access to a spouse's plan or are eligible for other coverage, compare it with your own employer's options. Marketplace coverage may be an option in some situations, so review eligibility rules.
segments.tr: 7. **考虑替代方案。** 如果您可以使用配偶的计划或有资格获得其他保险，请将其与您自己雇主的选项进行比较。在某些情况下，市场保险可能是一个选择，因此请审查资格规则。

segments.src: 8. **Confirm your choices.** Save your confirmation and review your first paycheck to make sure the deductions match what you selected.
segments.tr: 8. **确认您的选择。** 保存您的确认信息并检查您的第一张工资单，以确保扣除额与您选择的一致。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Rising health care and drug costs are shaping the benefits offered at many workplaces, and employees are often asked to cover more of the expense through premiums and deductibles.
segments.tr: 不断上涨的医疗保健和药物成本正在塑造许多工作场所提供的福利，员工通常被要求通过保费和免赔额承担更多的费用。

segments.src: The best response is to compare plans on total expected cost and fit with your health needs, not just the monthly premium.
segments.tr: 最好的应对方法是根据总预期成本和与您健康需求的契合度来比较计划，而不仅仅是看月保费。

segments.src: Taking an hour with your benefits materials now can help you avoid surprises later in the year.
segments.tr: 现在花一小时研究您的福利材料可以帮助您避免在今年晚些时候出现意外。

segments.src: *Because plan rules, tax limits, and eligibility requirements change, verify the details with your employer, your plan administrator, and official sources such as the IRS and Healthcare.gov before making decisions.*
segments.tr: *由于计划规则、税务限额和资格要求会发生变化，在做出决定之前，请与您的雇主、计划管理员以及IRS和Healthcare.gov等官方来源核实详细信息。*

segments.src: ## Why Costs Keep Rising
segments.tr: ## लागत क्यों बढ़ती रहती है

segments.src: Several forces tend to push employer plan costs up at the same time:
segments.tr: कई ताकतें एक ही समय में नियोक्ता योजना की लागत को ऊपर धकेलती हैं:

segments.src: - **Prescription drug spending.** Specialty medications and newer, high-cost therapies are a growing share of claims for many plans.
segments.tr: - **प्रिस्क्रिप्शन दवाओं पर खर्च।** विशेष दवाएं और नई, उच्च लागत वाली चिकित्सा पद्धतियां कई योजनाओं के लिए दावों का एक बढ़ता हुआ हिस्सा हैं।

segments.src: - **Plan renewals and insurer pricing.** Insurers and stop-loss carriers reset rates each year, and employers that self-fund their plans carry the risk of large claims directly.
segments.tr: - **योजना का नवीनीकरण और बीमाकर्ता मूल्य निर्धारण।** बीमाकर्ता और स्टॉप-लॉस वाहक हर साल दरों को रीसेट करते हैं, और जो नियोक्ता अपनी योजनाओं को स्वयं फंड करते हैं, वे सीधे बड़े दावों का जोखिम उठाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing shifts.** To hold down their own spending, employers may raise employee premium contributions, deductibles, copays, or out-of-pocket maximums, or they may narrow provider networks.
segments.tr: - **लागत-साझाकरण में बदलाव।** अपने स्वयं के खर्च को कम रखने के लिए, नियोक्ता कर्मचारी प्रीमियम योगदान, डिडक्टिबल्स, कोपे (copays), या आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट अधिकतम राशि बढ़ा सकते हैं, या वे प्रदाता नेटवर्क को सीमित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: The result is that a plan that looked familiar last year may cost more or work differently this year, even if the plan name has not changed.
segments.tr: परिणाम यह है कि जो योजना पिछले साल जानी-पहचानी लगती थी, वह इस साल अधिक महंगी हो सकती है या अलग तरह से काम कर सकती है, भले ही योजना का नाम नहीं बदला हो।

segments.src: ## What Changes You May See
segments.tr: ## आप क्या बदलाव देख सकते हैं

segments.src: Not every employer makes the same moves, but common adjustments include:
segments.tr: हर नियोक्ता एक जैसे कदम नहीं उठाता है, लेकिन सामान्य समायोजनों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Higher payroll deductions.** Your per-paycheck premium may rise, and the increase is often larger for family coverage.
segments.tr: 1. **उच्च पेरोल कटौती।** आपका प्रति-पेचेक प्रीमियम बढ़ सकता है, और परिवार कवरेज के लिए वृद्धि अक्सर बड़ी होती है।

segments.src: 2. **Bigger deductibles.** You may have to pay more out of pocket before the plan starts sharing costs.
segments.tr: 2. **बड़े डिडक्टिबल्स।** योजना द्वारा लागत साझा करना शुरू करने से पहले आपको अपनी जेब से अधिक भुगतान करना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: 3. **Higher out-of-pocket maximums.** This is the most you could pay in a plan year for covered, in-network care.
segments.tr: 3. **उच्च आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट अधिकतम।** यह वह अधिकतम राशि है जो आप एक योजना वर्ष में कवर की गई, इन-नेटवर्क देखभाल के लिए भुगतान कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Changes to drug coverage.** Look for tier changes, new prior-authorization rules, or different copays and coinsurance.
segments.tr: 4. **दवा कवरेज में बदलाव।** टियर में बदलाव, नए पूर्व-प्राधिकरण नियमों, या अलग कोपे और कॉइन्श्योरेंस (coinsurance) की तलाश करें।

segments.src: 5. **Network changes.** A doctor or hospital you use may move in or out of the network.
segments.tr: 5. **नेटवर्क में बदलाव।** आपके द्वारा उपयोग किया जाने वाला डॉक्टर या अस्पताल नेटवर्क में आ या जा सकता है।

segments.src: 6. **Fewer plan choices.** Some employers consolidate options or steer people toward high-deductible plans.
segments.tr: 6. **योजना के कम विकल्प।** कुछ नियोक्ता विकल्पों को समेकित करते हैं या लोगों को उच्च-डिडक्टिबल योजनाओं की ओर निर्देशित करते हैं।

segments.src: ## What to Compare Side by Side
segments.tr: ## साथ-साथ क्या तुलना करें

segments.src: Do not judge a plan by the premium alone.
segments.tr: केवल प्रीमियम के आधार पर योजना को न आंकें।

segments.src: Build a simple comparison for each option:
segments.tr: प्रत्येक विकल्प के लिए एक सरल तुलना बनाएं:

segments.src: | What to check | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | क्या जांचें | यह क्यों मायने रखता है |

segments.src: | Per-paycheck premium | Your guaranteed yearly cost, whether or not you use care |
segments.tr: | प्रति-पेचेक प्रीमियम | आपकी गारंटीकृत वार्षिक लागत, चाहे आप देखभाल का उपयोग करें या न करें |

segments.src: | Deductible (individual and family) | What you pay before most cost-sharing begins |
segments.tr: | डिडक्टिबल (व्यक्तिगत और परिवार) | अधिकांश लागत-साझाकरण शुरू होने से पहले आप जो भुगतान करते हैं |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case spending for covered in-network care |
segments.tr: | आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट अधिकतम | कवर की गई इन-नेटवर्क देखभाल के लिए आपका सबसे खराब स्थिति वाला खर्च |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | What you pay for visits, tests, and procedures |
segments.tr: | कोपे और कॉइन्श्योरेंस | विज़िट, परीक्षण और प्रक्रियाओं के लिए आप जो भुगतान करते हैं |

segments.src: | Prescription tiers | Whether your regular medications are covered and at what cost |
segments.tr: | प्रिस्क्रिप्शन टियर | क्या आपकी नियमित दवाएं कवर की गई हैं और किस लागत पर |

segments.src: | Network | Whether your doctors, specialists, and hospital are in-network |
segments.tr: | नेटवर्क | क्या आपके डॉक्टर, विशेषज्ञ और अस्पताल इन-नेटवर्क हैं |

segments.src: | Employer HSA or HRA contribution | Free money that can offset a higher deductible |
segments.tr: | नियोक्ता HSA या HRA योगदान | मुफ्त पैसा जो उच्च डिडक्टिबल की भरपाई कर सकता है |

segments.src: A helpful exercise: estimate your total yearly cost for each plan in two scenarios.
segments.tr: एक उपयोगी अभ्यास: दो परिदृश्यों में प्रत्येक योजना के लिए अपनी कुल वार्षिक लागत का अनुमान लगाएं।

segments.src: First, a **low-use year** (routine checkups and a few prescriptions).
segments.tr: पहला, एक **कम-उपयोग वाला वर्ष** (नियमित चेकअप और कुछ प्रिस्क्रिप्शन)।

segments.src: Second, a **high-use year** (a surgery, an emergency room visit, or a new ongoing treatment).
segments.tr: दूसरा, एक **उच्च-उपयोग वाला वर्ष** (सर्जरी, आपातकालीन कक्ष का दौरा, या कोई नया चल रहा उपचार)।

segments.src: Add the annual premiums to your likely out-of-pocket costs in each case.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक मामले में वार्षिक प्रीमियम को अपने संभावित आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट खर्चों में जोड़ें।

segments.src: The cheapest premium is not always the cheapest plan overall.
segments.tr: सबसे सस्ता प्रीमियम हमेशा कुल मिलाकर सबसे सस्ती योजना नहीं होती है।

segments.src: ## Understanding High-Deductible Plans and HSAs
segments.tr: ## उच्च-डिडक्टिबल योजनाओं और HSA को समझना

segments.src: Many employers are expanding high-deductible health plans (HDHPs).
segments.tr: कई नियोक्ता उच्च-डिडक्टिबल स्वास्थ्य योजनाओं (HDHPs) का विस्तार कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: These typically have lower premiums but higher deductibles.
segments.tr: इनमें आमतौर पर कम प्रीमियम लेकिन उच्च डिडक्टिबल्स होते हैं।

segments.src: If you are enrolled in a qualifying HDHP, you may be eligible to contribute to a **health savings account (HSA)**.
segments.tr: यदि आप एक योग्य HDHP में नामांकित हैं, तो आप **स्वास्थ्य बचत खाते (HSA)** में योगदान करने के पात्र हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: Key HSA features to know:
segments.tr: जानने योग्य मुख्य HSA विशेषताएं:

segments.src: - **Tax advantages.** Contributions are generally pre-tax or tax-deductible, growth is tax-free, and withdrawals for qualified medical expenses are tax-free. Review current IRS rules for details.
segments.tr: - **कर लाभ।** योगदान आमतौर पर कर-पूर्व या कर-कटौती योग्य होते हैं, वृद्धि कर-मुक्त होती है, और योग्य चिकित्सा खर्चों के लिए निकासी कर-मुक्त होती है। विवरण के लिए वर्तमान IRS नियमों की समीक्षा करें।

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits that adjust over time, with higher limits for family coverage and a catch-up amount for people age 55 and older. Check the IRS figures for 2027 before you set your contribution.
segments.tr: - **योगदान सीमाएं।** IRS वार्षिक सीमाएं निर्धारित करता है जो समय के साथ समायोजित होती हैं, परिवार कवरेज के लिए उच्च सीमाएं और 55 वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के लोगों के लिए कैच-अप राशि होती है। अपना योगदान निर्धारित करने से पहले 2027 के लिए IRS के आंकड़ों की जांच करें।

segments.src: - **Portability.** The money is yours and stays with you if you change jobs.
segments.tr: - **पोर्टेबिलिटी।** पैसा आपका है और यदि आप नौकरी बदलते हैं तो आपके साथ रहता है।

segments.src: - **Employer contributions.** Some employers add money to your HSA. This can meaningfully reduce the sting of a higher deductible, so compare it carefully.
segments.tr: - **नियोक्ता योगदान।** कुछ नियोक्ता आपके HSA में पैसा जोड़ते हैं। यह उच्च डिडक्टिबल की चुभन को काफी हद तक कम कर सकता है, इसलिए इसकी सावधानीपूर्वक तुलना करें।

segments.src: - **Eligibility limits.** Having certain other coverage, such as some general-purpose flexible spending accounts or other health coverage, can affect your eligibility. Read the plan rules.
segments.tr: - **पात्रता सीमाएं।** कुछ अन्य कवरेज होना, जैसे कि कुछ सामान्य-उद्देश्य वाले फ्लेक्सिबल स्पेंडिंग अकाउंट या अन्य स्वास्थ्य कवरेज, आपकी पात्रता को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं। योजना के नियम पढ़ें।

segments.src: An HDHP with an HSA can work well for people who are generally healthy and can afford to fund the account.
segments.tr: HSA के साथ एक HDHP उन लोगों के लिए अच्छा काम कर सकता है जो आम तौर पर स्वस्थ हैं और खाते को फंड करने का खर्च उठा सकते हैं।

segments.src: It can be harder for people who expect frequent care and may struggle to cover a large deductible up front.
segments.tr: यह उन लोगों के लिए कठिन हो सकता है जो बार-बार देखभाल की उम्मीद करते हैं और जिन्हें शुरू में एक बड़ा डिडक्टिबल कवर करने में संघर्ष करना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: ## Other Accounts and Benefits Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## अन्य खाते और लाभ जो देखने लायक हैं

segments.src: - **Flexible spending accounts (FSAs).** Health FSAs let you set aside pre-tax money, but they usually have "use it or lose it" limits with specific deadlines. Check how much can be carried over.
segments.tr: - **फ्लेक्सिबल स्पेंडिंग अकाउंट्स (FSAs)।** हेल्थ FSA आपको कर-पूर्व पैसा अलग रखने देते हैं, लेकिन उनमें आमतौर पर विशिष्ट समय सीमा के साथ "उपयोग करें या खो दें" की सीमाएं होती हैं। जांचें कि कितना आगे ले जाया जा सकता है।

segments.src: - **Dependent care FSAs.** These can help with eligible child or adult care costs.
segments.tr: - **आश्रित देखभाल FSA।** ये पात्र बच्चे या वयस्क देखभाल लागतों में मदद कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Telehealth and virtual care.** Some plans offer low-cost or free virtual visits that can reduce out-of-pocket spending for minor issues.
segments.tr: - **टेलीहेल्थ और वर्चुअल केयर।** कुछ योजनाएं कम लागत वाली या मुफ्त वर्चुअल विज़िट प्रदान करती हैं जो छोटी समस्याओं के लिए आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट खर्च को कम कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Mental health coverage.** Compare copays, visit limits, and whether therapists you use are in-network.
segments.tr: - **मानसिक स्वास्थ्य कवरेज।** कोपे, विज़िट सीमाएं और क्या आपके द्वारा उपयोग किए जाने वाले चिकित्सक इन-नेटवर्क हैं, इसकी तुलना करें।

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent rules.** Some employers add surcharges when a spouse has access to coverage elsewhere. Look for new surcharges or eligibility changes.
segments.tr: - **जीवनसाथी और आश्रित नियम।** कुछ नियोक्ता तब सरचार्ज जोड़ते हैं जब जीवनसाथी के पास कहीं और कवरेज तक पहुंच होती है। नए सरचार्ज या पात्रता परिवर्तनों की तलाश करें।

segments.src: ## Practical Steps Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## समय सीमा से पहले व्यावहारिक कदम

segments.src: 1. **Mark the dates.** Open enrollment windows are short, and missing one can lock you into your current choices for a year, outside of qualifying life events.
segments.tr: 1. **तारीखों को चिह्नित करें।** ओपन एनरोलमेंट विंडो छोटी होती हैं, और एक को चूकने से आप जीवन की योग्य घटनाओं के अलावा, एक साल के लिए अपने वर्तमान विकल्पों में फंस सकते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Read the summary of benefits and coverage.** Employers must provide standardized summaries that make plans easier to compare.
segments.tr: 2. **लाभ और कवरेज का सारांश पढ़ें।** नियोक्ताओं को मानकीकृत सारांश प्रदान करना चाहिए जो योजनाओं की तुलना करना आसान बनाते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Check your doctors and prescriptions.** Use the plan's provider directory and drug list, and confirm with your providers' offices when possible.
segments.tr: 3. **अपने डॉक्टरों और प्रिस्क्रिप्शन की जांच करें।** योजना की प्रदाता निर्देशिका और दवा सूची का उपयोग करें, और जब संभव हो तो अपने प्रदाताओं के कार्यालयों के साथ पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: 4. **Review last year's spending.** Your past claims and explanation-of-benefits statements are a useful guide to what you may need.
segments.tr: 4. **पिछले साल के खर्च की समीक्षा करें।** आपके पिछले दावे और लाभ-स्पष्टीकरण विवरण इस बात के लिए एक उपयोगी गाइड हैं कि आपको क्या चाहिए हो सकता है।

segments.src: 5. **Look at the whole picture.** Consider premiums, deductibles, HSA or FSA options, and employer contributions together.
segments.tr: 5. **पूरी तस्वीर देखें।** प्रीमियम, डिडक्टिबल्स, HSA या FSA विकल्प, और नियोक्ता योगदान पर एक साथ विचार करें।

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help.** Your HR or benefits team, plan portal, or benefits hotline can answer questions about the specifics.
segments.tr: 6. **मदद मांगें।** आपकी HR या बेनिफिट्स टीम, योजना पोर्टल, या बेनिफिट्स हॉटलाइन विशिष्टताओं के बारे में सवालों के जवाब दे सकती है।

segments.src: 7. **Think about alternatives.** If you have access to a spouse's plan or are eligible for other coverage, compare it with your own employer's options. Marketplace coverage may be an option in some situations, so review eligibility rules.
segments.tr: 7. **विकल्पों के बारे में सोचें।** यदि आपके पास जीवनसाथी की योजना तक पहुंच है या आप अन्य कवरेज के लिए पात्र हैं, तो इसकी तुलना अपने नियोक्ता के विकल्पों से करें। मार्केटप्लेस कवरेज कुछ स्थितियों में एक विकल्प हो सकता है, इसलिए पात्रता नियमों की समीक्षा करें।

segments.src: 8. **Confirm your choices.** Save your confirmation and review your first paycheck to make sure the deductions match what you selected.
segments.tr: 8. **अपने विकल्पों की पुष्टि करें।** अपनी पुष्टि को सहेजें और अपने पहले पेचेक की समीक्षा करें ताकि यह सुनिश्चित हो सके कि कटौती आपके द्वारा चुने गए विकल्पों से मेल खाती है।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.tr: बढ़ती स्वास्थ्य देखभाल और दवा की लागत कई कार्यस्थलों पर पेश किए जाने वाले लाभों को आकार दे रही है, और कर्मचारियों से अक्सर प्रीमियम और डिडक्टिबल्स के माध्यम से खर्च का अधिक हिस्सा कवर करने के लिए कहा जाता है।

segments.tr: सबसे अच्छी प्रतिक्रिया यह है कि योजनाओं की तुलना कुल अपेक्षित लागत और आपकी स्वास्थ्य आवश्यकताओं के साथ फिट होने के आधार पर करें, न कि केवल मासिक प्रीमियम के आधार पर।

segments.src: Taking an hour with your benefits materials now can help you avoid surprises later in the year.
segments.tr: अभी अपनी बेनिफिट्स सामग्री के साथ एक घंटा बिताने से आपको साल में बाद में आश्चर्य से बचने में मदद मिल सकती है।

segments.src: *Because plan rules, tax limits, and eligibility requirements change, verify the details with your employer, your plan administrator, and official sources such as the IRS and Healthcare.gov before making decisions.*
segments.tr: *चूंकि योजना के नियम, कर सीमाएं और पात्रता आवश्यकताएं बदलती रहती हैं, इसलिए निर्णय लेने से पहले अपने नियोक्ता, अपने योजना प्रशासक और IRS और Healthcare.gov जैसे आधिकारिक स्रोतों के साथ विवरण सत्यापित करें।*

es.title: Planes de salud para empleadores 2027: por qué la inscripción abierta suele significar primas más altas y deducibles más grandes

segments.src: As open enrollment season begins at many workplaces, a familiar pattern is showing up in benefits packets: the cost of coverage is rising, and more of that cost is landing on employees.
segments.tr: Mientras la temporada de inscripción abierta comienza en muchos lugares de trabajo, en los paquetes de beneficios aparece un patrón conocido: el costo de la cobertura sube y una parte cada vez mayor de ese costo recae en los empleados.

segments.src: Surveys from benefits consultants and industry groups have pointed to continued increases in medical and prescription drug spending, and many employers say they are adjusting plan designs to manage the bill.
segments.tr: Las encuestas de consultoras de beneficios y de asociaciones del sector han señalado aumentos continuos en el gasto médico y en medicamentos recetados, y muchos empleadores afirman que están ajustando el diseño de sus planes para controlar la factura.

segments.src: This guide explains why premiums and deductibles tend to climb, what to compare when you review your options for 2027, and how to avoid common mistakes before your enrollment window closes.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica por qué las primas y los deducibles tienden a subir, qué comparar al revisar sus opciones para 2027 y cómo evitar errores comunes antes de que cierre el periodo de inscripción.

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is for general information only. It is not medical, tax, legal, or financial advice. Plan details vary widely, so always check your own employer's official materials.
segments.tr: > **Nota:** Este artículo es solo informativo. No constituye asesoramiento médico, fiscal, legal ni financiero. Los detalles de los planes varían mucho, así que siempre consulte los materiales oficiales de su empleador.

segments.src: ## Why Costs Keep Rising
segments.tr: ## ¿Por qué los costos siguen subiendo?

segments.src: Several forces tend to push employer plan costs up at the same time:
segments.tr: Varias fuerzas tienden a presionar al alza los costos de los planes de los empleadores al mismo tiempo:

segments.src: - **Higher medical prices and use of care.** Hospital and provider costs, along with greater use of services, can raise what a plan pays out.
segments.tr: - **Precios médicos más altos y mayor uso de la atención.** Los costos de hospitales y proveedores, junto con un mayor uso de servicios, pueden aumentar lo que paga el plan.

segments.src: - **Prescription drug spending.** Specialty medications and newer, high-cost therapies are a growing share of claims for many plans.
segments.tr: - **Gasto en medicamentos recetados.** Los medicamentos especializados y las terapias nuevas de alto costo representan una parte creciente de los reclamos en muchos planes.

segments.src: - **Plan renewals and insurer pricing.** Insurers and stop-loss carriers reset rates each year, and employers that self-fund their plans carry the risk of large claims directly.
segments.tr: - **Renovaciones de planes y precios de las aseguradoras.** Las aseguradoras y las aseguradoras de exceso de pérdida (stop-loss) recalculan las tarifas cada año, y los empleadores que autofinancian sus planes asumen directamente el riesgo de los reclamos de gran monto.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing shifts.** To hold down their own spending, employers may raise employee premium contributions, deductibles, copays, or out-of-pocket maximums, or they may narrow provider networks.
segments.tr: - **Cambios en la participación en costos.** Para contener su propio gasto, los empleadores pueden aumentar las contribuciones de las primas a cargo del empleado, los deducibles, los copagos o los máximos de gasto de bolsillo, o pueden reducir las redes de proveedores.

segments.src: The result is that a plan that looked familiar last year may cost more or work differently this year, even if the plan name has not changed.
segments.tr: El resultado es que un plan que parecía familiar el año pasado puede costar más o funcionar de forma diferente este año, aunque el nombre del plan no haya cambiado.

segments.src: ## What Changes You May See
segments.tr: ## Qué cambios puede ver

segments.src: Not every employer makes the same moves, but common adjustments include:
segments.tr: No todos los empleadores hacen los mismos ajustes, pero los cambios comunes incluyen:

segments.src: 1. **Higher payroll deductions.** Your per-paycheck premium may rise, and the increase is often larger for family coverage.
segments.tr: 1. **Descuentos de nómina más altos.** La prima que se descuenta en cada cheque de pago puede subir, y el aumento suele ser mayor en la cobertura familiar.

segments.src: 2. **Bigger deductibles.** You may have to pay more out of pocket before the plan starts sharing costs.
segments.tr: 2. **Deducibles más grandes.** Es posible que deba pagar más de su bolsillo antes de que el plan empiece a compartir los costos.

segments.src: 3. **Higher out-of-pocket maximums.** This is the most you could pay in a plan year for covered, in-network care.
segments.tr: 3. **Máximos de gasto de bolsillo más altos.** Es la cantidad máxima que podría pagar en un año del plan por atención cubierta dentro de la red.

segments.src: 4. **Changes to drug coverage.** Look for tier changes, new prior-authorization rules, or different copays and coinsurance.
segments.tr: 4. **Cambios en la cobertura de medicamentos.** Busque cambios de nivel (tier), nuevas reglas de autorización previa o copagos y coseguros diferentes.

segments.src: 5. **Network changes.** A doctor or hospital you use may move in or out of the network.
segments.tr: 5. **Cambios en la red.** Un médico o un hospital que usted utiliza puede entrar o salir de la red.

segments.src: 6. **Fewer plan choices.** Some employers consolidate options or steer people toward high-deductible plans.
segments.tr: 6. **Menos opciones de plan.** Algunos empleadores consolidan las opciones o dirigen a las personas hacia planes de alto deducible.

segments.src: ## What to Compare Side by Side
segments.tr: ## Qué comparar lado a lado

segments.src: Do not judge a plan by the premium alone.
segments.tr: No juzgue un plan solo por la prima.

segments.src: Build a simple comparison for each option:
segments.tr: Elabore una comparación sencilla para cada opción:

segments.src: | What to check | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | Qué revisar | Por qué importa |

segments.src: | Per-paycheck premium | Your guaranteed yearly cost, whether or not you use care |
segments.tr: | Prima por cheque de pago | Su costo anual garantizado, use o no la atención |

segments.src: | Deductible (individual and family) | What you pay before most cost-sharing begins |
segments.tr: | Deducible (individual y familiar) | Lo que paga antes de que comience la mayor parte de la participación en costos |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case spending for covered in-network care |
segments.tr: | Máximo de gasto de bolsillo | Su gasto en el peor escenario por atención cubierta dentro de la red |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | What you pay for visits, tests, and procedures |
segments.tr: | Copagos y coseguros | Lo que paga por consultas, pruebas y procedimientos |

segments.src: | Prescription tiers | Whether your regular medications are covered and at what cost |
segments.tr: | Niveles de medicamentos recetados | Si sus medicamentos habituales están cubiertos y a qué costo |

segments.src: | Network | Whether your doctors, specialists, and hospital are in-network |
segments.tr: | Red | Si sus médicos, especialistas y hospital están dentro de la red |

segments.src: | Employer HSA or HRA contribution | Free money that can offset a higher deductible |
segments.tr: | Aportación del empleador a HSA o HRA | Dinero gratis que puede compensar un deducible más alto |

segments.src: A helpful exercise: estimate your total yearly cost for each plan in two scenarios.
segments.tr: Un ejercicio útil: estime su costo anual total para cada plan en dos escenarios.

segments.src: First, a **low-use year** (routine checkups and a few prescriptions).
segments.tr: Primero, un **año de bajo uso** (chequeos de rutina y algunas recetas).

segments.src: Second, a **high-use year** (a surgery, an emergency room visit, or a new ongoing treatment).
segments.tr: Segundo, un **año de alto uso** (una cirugía, una visita a urgencias o un tratamiento continuo nuevo).

segments.src: Add the annual premiums to your likely out-of-pocket costs in each case.
segments.tr: Sume las primas anuales a sus costos de bolsillo probables en cada caso.

segments.src: The cheapest premium is not always the cheapest plan overall.
segments.tr: La prima más barata no siempre es el plan más barato en conjunto.

segments.src: ## Understanding High-Deductible Plans and HSAs
segments.tr: ## Entender los planes de alto deducible y las HSA

segments.src: Many employers are expanding high-deductible health plans (HDHPs).
segments.tr: Muchos empleadores están ampliando los planes de salud de alto deducible (HDHP, por sus siglas en inglés).

segments.src: These typically have lower premiums but higher deductibles.
segments.tr: Por lo general tienen primas más bajas pero deducibles más altos.

segments.src: If you are enrolled in a qualifying HDHP, you may be eligible to contribute to a **health savings account (HSA)**.
segments.tr: Si está inscrito en un HDHP que califique, es posible que pueda aportar a una **cuenta de ahorro para la salud (HSA)**.

segments.src: Key HSA features to know:
segments.tr: Características clave de las HSA que conviene conocer:

segments.src: - **Tax advantages.** Contributions are generally pre-tax or tax-deductible, growth is tax-free, and withdrawals for qualified medical expenses are tax-free. Review current IRS rules for details.
segments.tr: - **Ventajas fiscales.** Las aportaciones generalmente son antes de impuestos o deducibles de impuestos, el crecimiento está libre de impuestos y los retiros para gastos médicos calificados también. Revise las normas vigentes del IRS para ver los detalles.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits that adjust over time, with higher limits for family coverage and a catch-up amount for people age 55 and older. Check the IRS figures for 2027 before you set your contribution.
segments.tr: - **Límites de aportación.** El IRS fija límites anuales que se ajustan con el tiempo, con límites más altos para la cobertura familiar y un monto adicional para personas de 55 años o más. Consulte las cifras del IRS para 2027 antes de definir su aportación.

segments.src: - **Portability.** The money is yours and stays with you if you change jobs.
segments.tr: - **Portabilidad.** El dinero es suyo y se queda con usted si cambia de empleo.

segments.src: - **Employer contributions.** Some employers add money to your HSA. This can meaningfully reduce the sting of a higher deductible, so compare it carefully.
segments.tr: - **Aportaciones del empleador.** Algunos empleadores añaden dinero a su HSA. Esto puede reducir de forma considerable el golpe de un deducible más alto, así que compárelo con cuidado.

segments.src: - **Eligibility limits.** Having certain other coverage, such as some general-purpose flexible spending accounts or other health coverage, can affect your eligibility. Read the plan rules.
segments.tr: - **Límites de elegibilidad.** Tener ciertas otras coberturas, como algunas cuentas de gastos flexibles de uso general u otros seguros de salud, puede afectar su elegibilidad. Lea las reglas del plan.

segments.src: An HDHP with an HSA can work well for people who are generally healthy and can afford to fund the account.
segments.tr: Un HDHP con HSA puede funcionar bien para personas generalmente sanas que pueden costear el fondeo de la cuenta.

segments.src: It can be harder for people who expect frequent care and may struggle to cover a large deductible up front.
segments.tr: Puede ser más difícil para quienes esperan recibir atención con frecuencia y podrían tener problemas para cubrir un deducible alto por adelantado.

segments.src: ## Other Accounts and Benefits Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## Otras cuentas y beneficios que vale la pena revisar

segments.src: - **Flexible spending accounts (FSAs).** Health FSAs let you set aside pre-tax money, but they usually have "use it or lose it" limits with specific deadlines. Check how much can be carried over.
segments.tr: - **Cuentas de gastos flexibles (FSA).** Las FSA de salud le permiten apartar dinero antes de impuestos, pero normalmente tienen límites de “úselo o piérdalo” con plazos específicos. Revise cuánto se puede trasladar al año siguiente.

segments.src: - **Dependent care FSAs.** These can help with eligible child or adult care costs.
segments.tr: - **FSA para cuidado de dependientes.** Pueden ayudar con gastos elegibles de cuidado de hijos o de adultos.

segments.src: - **Telehealth and virtual care.** Some plans offer low-cost or free virtual visits that can reduce out-of-pocket spending for minor issues.
segments.tr: - **Telemedicina y atención virtual.** Algunos planes ofrecen consultas virtuales de bajo costo o gratuitas, lo que puede reducir el gasto de bolsillo en problemas menores.

segments.src: - **Mental health coverage.** Compare copays, visit limits, and whether therapists you use are in-network.
segments.tr: - **Cobertura de salud mental.** Compare copagos, límites de visitas y si los terapeutas que usa están dentro de la red.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent rules.** Some employers add surcharges when a spouse has access to coverage elsewhere. Look for new surcharges or eligibility changes.
segments.tr: - **Reglas para cónyuges y dependientes.** Algunos empleadores aplican recargos cuando el cónyuge tiene acceso a una cobertura en otro lugar. Busque nuevos recargos o cambios en la elegibilidad.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## Pasos prácticos antes de la fecha límite

segments.src: 1. **Mark the dates.** Open enrollment windows are short, and missing one can lock you into your current choices for a year, outside of qualifying life events.
segments.tr: 1. **Marque las fechas.** Las ventanas de inscripción abierta son breves, y perder una puede dejarle atado a sus opciones actuales durante un año, salvo eventos de vida que lo califiquen.

segments.src: 2. **Read the summary of benefits and coverage.** Employers must provide standardized summaries that make plans easier to compare.
segments.tr: 2. **Lea el resumen de beneficios y cobertura.** Los empleadores deben proporcionar resúmenes estandarizados que facilitan la comparación de planes.

segments.src: 3. **Check your doctors and prescriptions.** Use the plan's provider directory and drug list, and confirm with your providers' offices when possible.
segments.tr: 3. **Revise sus médicos y recetas.** Use el directorio de proveedores y la lista de medicamentos del plan, y confirme con las oficinas de sus proveedores cuando sea posible.

segments.src: 4. **Review last year's spending.** Your past claims and explanation-of-benefits statements are a useful guide to what you may need.
segments.tr: 4. **Revise el gasto del año pasado.** Sus reclamos anteriores y los estados de explicación de beneficios son una guía útil de lo que podría necesitar.

segments.src: 5. **Look at the whole picture.** Consider premiums, deductibles, HSA or FSA options, and employer contributions together.
segments.tr: 5. **Vea el panorama completo.** Considere en conjunto las primas, los deducibles, las opciones de HSA o FSA y las aportaciones del empleador.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help.** Your HR or benefits team, plan portal, or benefits hotline can answer questions about the specifics.
segments.tr: 6. **Pida ayuda.** Su departamento de recursos humanos o de beneficios, el portal del plan o la línea de atención de beneficios pueden responder preguntas sobre los detalles.

segments.src: 7. **Think about alternatives.** If you have access to a spouse's plan or are eligible for other coverage, compare it with your own employer's options. Marketplace coverage may be an option in some situations, so review eligibility rules.
segments.tr: 7. **Considere alternativas.** Si tiene acceso al plan de su cónyuge o es elegible para otra cobertura, compárela con las opciones de su propio empleador. El seguro del mercado de seguros de salud puede ser una opción en algunas situaciones, así que revise las reglas de elegibilidad.

segments.src: 8. **Confirm your choices.** Save your confirmation and review your first paycheck to make sure the deductions match what you selected.
segments.tr: 8. **Confirme sus elecciones.** Guarde su confirmación y revise su primer cheque de pago para asegurarse de que los descuentos coincidan con lo que seleccionó.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En resumen

segments.src: Rising health care and drug costs are shaping the benefits offered at many workplaces, and employees are often asked to cover more of the expense through premiums and deductibles.
segments.tr: El aumento de los costos de la atención médica y de los medicamentos está dando forma a los beneficios que ofrecen muchos lugares de trabajo, y a menudo se pide a los empleados que cubran una mayor parte del gasto mediante primas y deducibles.

segments.src: The best response is to compare plans on total expected cost and fit with your health needs, not just the monthly premium.
segments.tr: La mejor respuesta es comparar los planes según el costo total esperado y su adecuación a sus necesidades de salud, no solo la prima mensual.

segments.src: Taking an hour with your benefits materials now can help you avoid surprises later in the year.
segments.tr: Dedicar una hora a sus materiales de beneficios ahora puede ayudarle a evitar sorpresas más adelante en el año.

segments.src: *Because plan rules, tax limits, and eligibility requirements change, verify the details with your employer, your plan administrator, and official sources such as the IRS and Healthcare.gov before making decisions.*
segments.tr: *Como las reglas de los planes, los límites fiscales y los requisitos de elegibilidad cambian, verifique los detalles con su empleador, el administrador del plan y fuentes oficiales como el IRS y Healthcare.gov antes de tomar decisiones.*

segments.tr: - **تحويل تحمّل التكلفة.** لخفض إنفاقهم، قد يرفع أصحاب العمل مساهمات الموظفين في الأقساط أو الخصومات أو الرسوم المشتركة (copays) أو الحدود القصوى للإنفاق من الجيب، أو قد يقلصون شبكات مقدمي الخدمات.

segments.src: The result is that a plan that looked familiar last year may cost more or work differently this year, even if the plan name has not changed.
segments.tr: النتيجة أن الخطة التي بدت مألوفة العام الماضي قد تكلف أكثر أو تعمل بشكل مختلف هذا العام، حتى لو لم يتغير اسمها.

segments.src: ## What Changes You May See
segments.tr: ## التغييرات التي قد تراها

segments.src: Not every employer makes the same moves, but common adjustments include:
segments.tr: ليس كل صاحب عمل يتخذ الخطوات نفسها، لكن من التعديلات الشائعة:

segments.src: 1. **Higher payroll deductions.** Your per-paycheck premium may rise, and the increase is often larger for family coverage.
segments.tr: 1. **ارتفاع الاقتطاعات من الراتب.** قد يرتفع القسط المقتطع من كل راتب، وغالباً ما تكون الزيادة أكبر لتغطية الأسرة.

segments.src: 2. **Bigger deductibles.** You may have to pay more out of pocket before the plan starts sharing costs.
segments.tr: 2. **خصومات أكبر.** قد تضطر إلى دفع مبلغ أكبر من جيبك قبل أن تبدأ الخطة في تحمّل التكاليف.

segments.src: 3. **Higher out-of-pocket maximums.** This is the most you could pay in a plan year for covered, in-network care.
segments.tr: 3. **حدود أعلى للإنفاق من الجيب.** وهذا أقصى مبلغ قد تدفعه في سنة الخطة مقابل الرعاية المغطاة داخل الشبكة.

segments.src: 4. **Changes to drug coverage.** Look for tier changes, new prior-authorization rules, or different copays and coinsurance.
segments.tr: 4. **تغييرات في تغطية الأدوية.** انتبه إلى تغيير الفئات (tiers)، وقواعد الموافقة المسبقة الجديدة، أو اختلاف رسوم الدفع المشترك (copays) ونسب المشاركة (coinsurance).

segments.src: 5. **Network changes.** A doctor or hospital you use may move in or out of the network.
segments.tr: 5. **تغييرات في الشبكة.** قد ينتقل طبيب أو مستشفى تستخدمه إلى داخل الشبكة أو خارجها.

segments.src: 6. **Fewer plan choices.** Some employers consolidate options or steer people toward high-deductible plans.
segments.tr: 6. **خيارات أقل في الخطط.** بعض أصحاب العمل يدمجون الخيارات أو يوجهون الموظفين نحو الخطط ذات الخصومات المرتفعة.

segments.src: ## What to Compare Side by Side
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يجب مقارنته جنباً إلى جنب

segments.src: Do not judge a plan by the premium alone.
segments.tr: لا تحكم على الخطة من خلال القسط وحده.

segments.src: Build a simple comparison for each option:
segments.tr: ضع مقارنة بسيطة لكل خيار:

segments.src: | What to check | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | ما الذي يُفحص | لماذا يهم |

segments.src: | Per-paycheck premium | Your guaranteed yearly cost, whether or not you use care |
segments.tr: | القسط المقتطع من الراتب | تكلفتك السنوية المضمونة، سواء استخدمت الرعاية أم لا |

segments.src: | Deductible (individual and family) | What you pay before most cost-sharing begins |
segments.tr: | الخصم (فردي وعائلي) | ما تدفعه قبل أن يبدأ معظم تحمّل التكاليف |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case spending for covered in-network care |
segments.tr: | الحد الأقصى للإنفاق من الجيب | أسوأ حالة إنفاق لديك للرعاية المغطاة داخل الشبكة |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | What you pay for visits, tests, and procedures |
segments.tr: | الرسوم المشتركة (copays) ونسب المشاركة (coinsurance) | ما تدفعه مقابل الزيارات والفحوص والإجراءات |

segments.src: | Prescription tiers | Whether your regular medications are covered and at what cost |
segments.tr: | فئات الأدوية | هل أدويتك المنتظمة مغطاة، وبأي تكلفة |

segments.src: | Network | Whether your doctors, specialists, and hospital are in-network |
segments.tr: | الشبكة | هل أطباؤك وأخصائيوك ومستشفاك داخل الشبكة |

segments.src: | Employer HSA or HRA contribution | Free money that can offset a higher deductible |
segments.tr: | مساهمة صاحب العمل في HSA أو HRA | مال مجاني يمكن أن يعوّض خصماً أعلى |

segments.src: A helpful exercise: estimate your total yearly cost for each plan in two scenarios.
segments.tr: تمرين مفيد: قدّر تكلفتك السنوية الإجمالية لكل خطة في سيناريوهين.

segments.src: First, a **low-use year** (routine checkups and a few prescriptions).
segments.tr: أولاً، **سنة استخدام منخفض** (فحوص روتينية وبعض الوصفات).

segments.src: Second, a **high-use year** (a surgery, an emergency room visit, or a new ongoing treatment).
segments.tr: ثانياً، **سنة استخدام مرتفع** (عملية جراحية، أو زيارة لغرفة الطوارئ، أو علاج مستمر جديد).

segments.src: Add the annual premiums to your likely out-of-pocket costs in each case.
segments.tr: أضف الأقساط السنوية إلى ما ستدفعه من جيبك في كل حالة.

segments.src: The cheapest premium is not always the cheapest plan overall.
segments.tr: القسط الأرخص ليس دائماً الخطة الأرخص إجمالاً.

segments.src: ## Understanding High-Deductible Plans and HSAs
segments.tr: ## فهم الخطط ذات الخصومات المرتفعة وحسابات HSA

segments.src: Many employers are expanding high-deductible health plans (HDHPs).
segments.tr: توسّع كثير من أصحاب العمل في خطط الرعاية الصحية ذات الخصومات المرتفعة (HDHP).

segments.src: These typically have lower premiums but higher deductibles.
segments.tr: وعادة ما تكون أقساطها أقل لكن خصوماتها أعلى.

segments.src: If you are enrolled in a qualifying HDHP, you may be eligible to contribute to a **health savings account (HSA)**.
segments.tr: إذا كنت مسجلاً في خطة HDHP مؤهلة، فقد يحق لك المساهمة في **حساب توفير الرعاية الصحية (HSA)**.

segments.src: Key HSA features to know:
segments.tr: ميزات HSA الرئيسية التي ينبغي معرفتها:

segments.src: - **Tax advantages.** Contributions are generally pre-tax or tax-deductible, growth is tax-free, and withdrawals for qualified medical expenses are tax-free. Review current IRS rules for details.
segments.tr: - **المزايا الضريبية.** المساهمات عادة قبل الضريبة أو قابلة للخصم الضريبي، والنمو معفى من الضريبة، والسحب لأغراض النفقات الطبية المؤهلة معفى من الضريبة. راجع قواعد مصلحة الضرائب الأمريكية (IRS) الحالية للتفاصيل.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits that adjust over time, with higher limits for family coverage and a catch-up amount for people age 55 and older. Check the IRS figures for 2027 before you set your contribution.
segments.tr: - **حدود المساهمة.** تحدد مصلحة الضرائب حدوداً سنوية تتغير بمرور الوقت، مع حدود أعلى لتغطية الأسرة ومبلغ تعويضي إضافي لمن تبلغ أعمارهم 55 عاماً فأكثر. راجع أرقام IRS لعام 2027 قبل تحديد مساهمتك.

segments.src: - **Portability.** The money is yours and stays with you if you change jobs.
segments.tr: - **قابلية النقل.** المال ملكك ويبقى معك إذا غيّرت عملك.

segments.src: - **Employer contributions.** Some employers add money to your HSA. This can meaningfully reduce the sting of a higher deductible, so compare it carefully.
segments.tr: - **مساهمات صاحب العمل.** بعض أصحاب العمل يضيفون أموالاً إلى حسابك في HSA. وهذا قد يخفف بشكل ملموس وطأة الخصم الأعلى، لذا قارنه بعناية.

segments.src: - **Eligibility limits.** Having certain other coverage, such as some general-purpose flexible spending accounts or other health coverage, can affect your eligibility. Read the plan rules.
segments.tr: - **حدود الأهلية.** وجود تغطية أخرى معينة، مثل بعض حسابات الإنفاق المرن (FSA) العامة أو تغطيات صحية أخرى، قد يؤثر على أهليتك. اقرأ قواعد الخطة.

segments.src: An HDHP with an HSA can work well for people who are generally healthy and can afford to fund the account.
segments.tr: قد تكون خطة HDHP مع HSA مناسبة جداً للأشخاص الذين يتمتعون عموماً بصحة جيدة وقادرين على تمويل الحساب.

segments.src: It can be harder for people who expect frequent care and may struggle to cover a large deductible up front.
segments.tr: لكنها قد تكون أصعب على من يتوقعون رعاية متكررة وقد يجدون صعوبة في تغطية خصم كبير مقدماً.

segments.src: ## Other Accounts and Benefits Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## حسابات ومزايا أخرى تستحق النظر

segments.src: - **Flexible spending accounts (FSAs).** Health FSAs let you set aside pre-tax money, but they usually have "use it or lose it" limits with specific deadlines. Check how much can be carried over.
segments.tr: - **حسابات الإنفاق المرن (FSA).** تتيح لك حسابات FSA الصحية ادخار مال قبل الضريبة، لكنها عادة تحمل قيود «استخدمه أو تخسره» مع مواعيد نهائية محددة. تحقق من المبلغ الذي يمكن ترحيله إلى العام التالي.

segments.src: - **Dependent care FSAs.** These can help with eligible child or adult care costs.
segments.tr: - **حسابات الإنفاق المرن لرعاية المعالين.** يمكن أن تساعد في تكاليف رعاية الطفل أو البالغ المؤهلة.

segments.src: - **Telehealth and virtual care.** Some plans offer low-cost or free virtual visits that can reduce out-of-pocket spending for minor issues.
segments.tr: - **الرعاية الصحية عن بُعد والافتراضية.** بعض الخطط توفر زيارات افتراضية منخفضة التكلفة أو مجانية، ما قد يقلل الإنفاق من الجيب على الحالات البسيطة.

segments.src: - **Mental health coverage.** Compare copays, visit limits, and whether therapists you use are in-network.
segments.tr: - **تغطية الصحة النفسية.** قارن بين الرسوم المشتركة، وحدود عدد الزيارات، وهل المعالجون الذين تتعامل معهم داخل الشبكة.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent rules.** Some employers add surcharges when a spouse has access to coverage elsewhere. Look for new surcharges or eligibility changes.
segments.tr: - **قواعد الزوج والمعالين.** بعض أصحاب العمل يفرضون رسوماً إضافية عندما يكون للزوج/الزوجة تغطية متاحة من مكان آخر. ابحث عن رسوم جديدة أو تغييرات في الأهلية.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## خطوات عملية قبل الموعد النهائي

segments.src: 1. **Mark the dates.** Open enrollment windows are short, and missing one can lock you into your current choices for a year, outside of qualifying life events.
segments.tr: 1. **حدد التواريخ.** نوافذ التسجيل المفتوح قصيرة، والفوات قد يحبسك في اختياراتك الحالية لمدة عام، خارج أحداث الحياة المؤهلة.

segments.src: 2. **Read the summary of benefits and coverage.** Employers must provide standardized summaries that make plans easier to compare.
segments.tr: 2. **اقرأ ملخص المزايا والتغطية.** يلزم أصحاب العمل بتقديم ملخصات موحدة تجعل الخطط أسهل للمقارنة.

segments.src: 3. **Check your doctors and prescriptions.** Use the plan's provider directory and drug list, and confirm with your providers' offices when possible.
segments.tr: 3. **تحقق من أطبائك ووصفاتك.** استخدم دليل مقدمي الخدمات وقائمة الأدوية الخاصة بالخطة، وأكد مع مكاتب مقدمي الخدمات عندما يكون ذلك ممكناً.

segments.src: 4. **Review last year's spending.** Your past claims and explanation-of-benefits statements are a useful guide to what you may need.
segments.tr: 4. **راجع إنفاق العام الماضي.** مطالباتك السابقة وكشوف شرح المزايا (EOB) دليل مفيد لما قد تحتاجه.

segments.src: 5. **Look at the whole picture.** Consider premiums, deductibles, HSA or FSA options, and employer contributions together.
segments.tr: 5. **انظر إلى الصورة الكاملة.** ضع في الاعتبار الأقساط والخصومات وخيارات HSA أو FSA ومساهمات صاحب العمل معاً.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help.** Your HR or benefits team, plan portal, or benefits hotline can answer questions about the specifics.
segments.tr: 6. **اطلب المساعدة.** يمكن لفريق الموارد البشرية أو المزايا، أو بوابة الخطة، أو خط المساعدة الخاص بالمزايا، الإجابة عن الأسئلة التفصيلية.

segments.src: 7. **Think about alternatives.** If you have access to a spouse's plan or are eligible for other coverage, compare it with your own employer's options. Marketplace coverage may be an option in some situations, so review eligibility rules.
segments.tr: 7. **فكّر في البدائل.** إذا كان لديك وصول إلى خطة الزوج/الزوجة أو كنت مؤهلاً لتغطية أخرى، قارنها بخيارات صاحب عملك. قد تكون تغطية السوق (Marketplace) خياراً في بعض الحالات، لذا راجع قواعد الأهلية.

segments.src: 8. **Confirm your choices.** Save your confirmation and review your first paycheck to make sure the deductions match what you selected.
segments.tr: 8. **أكّد اختياراتك.** احفظ تأكيد التسجيل وراجع أول راتب لديك للتأكد من أن الاقتطاعات تطابق ما اخترته.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Rising health care and drug costs are shaping the benefits offered at many workplaces, and employees are often asked to cover more of the expense through premiums and deductibles.
segments.tr: ترتفع تكاليف الرعاية الصحية والأدوية وتشكّل المزايا المقدمة في كثير من أماكن العمل، ويُطلب من الموظفين غالباً تغطية جزء أكبر من النفقات عبر الأقساط والخصومات.

segments.src: The best response is to compare plans on total expected cost and fit with your health needs, not just the monthly premium.
segments.tr: أفضل رد هو مقارنة الخطط وفق إجمالي التكلفة المتوقعة ومدى ملاءمتها لاحتياجاتك الصحية، لا وفق القسط الشهري وحده.

segments.src: Taking an hour with your benefits materials now can help you avoid surprises later in the year.
segments.tr: خصص ساعة لمراجعة مواد مزاياك الآن، فقد يساعدك ذلك على تجنب المفاجآت لاحقاً خلال العام.

segments.src: *Because plan rules, tax limits, and eligibility requirements change, verify the details with your employer, your plan administrator, and official sources such as the IRS and Healthcare.gov before making decisions.*
segments.tr: *لأن قواعد الخطط والحدود الضريبية ومتطلبات الأهلية تتغير، تحقق من التفاصيل مع صاحب عملك ومدير خطتك والمصادر الرسمية مثل IRS وHealthcare.gov قبل اتخاذ القرارات.*

fr.title: Plans de santé d'employeur 2027 : pourquoi l'inscription annuelle entraîne souvent des primes plus élevées et des franchises plus importantes

segments.src: As open enrollment season begins at many workplaces, a familiar pattern is showing up in benefits packets: the cost of coverage is rising, and more of that cost is landing on employees.
segments.tr: Alors que la période d'inscription annuelle débute dans de nombreuses entreprises, un schéma familier apparaît dans les dossiers d'avantages sociaux : le coût de la couverture augmente, et une part croissante de ce coût retombe sur les salariés.

segments.src: Surveys from benefits consultants and industry groups have pointed to continued increases in medical and prescription drug spending, and many employers say they are adjusting plan designs to manage the bill.
segments.tr: Les enquêtes menées par les cabinets de conseil en avantages sociaux et les organisations sectorielles font état de hausses continues des dépenses médicales et de médicaments sur ordonnance, et de nombreux employeurs déclarent adapter la conception de leurs régimes pour maîtriser la facture.

segments.src: This guide explains why premiums and deductibles tend to climb, what to compare when you review your options for 2027, and how to avoid common mistakes before your enrollment window closes.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique pourquoi les primes et les franchises ont tendance à augmenter, ce qu'il faut comparer lorsque vous examinez vos options pour 2027, et comment éviter les erreurs courantes avant la fermeture de la période d'inscription.

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is for general information only. It is not medical, tax, legal, or financial advice. Plan details vary widely, so always check your own employer's official materials.
segments.tr: > **Remarque :** Cet article est uniquement fourni à titre d'information générale. Il ne constitue pas un avis médical, fiscal, juridique ou financier. Les détails des régimes varient considérablement ; vérifiez donc toujours les documents officiels de votre employeur.

segments.src: ## Why Costs Keep Rising
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les coûts continuent d'augmenter

segments.src: Several forces tend to push employer plan costs up at the same time:
segments.tr: Plusieurs facteurs tendent à faire grimper simultanément les coûts des régimes d'employeur :

segments.src: - **Higher medical prices and use of care.** Hospital and provider costs, along with greater use of services, can raise what a plan pays out.
segments.tr: - **Hausse des prix médicaux et du recours aux soins.** Les coûts hospitaliers et ceux des prestataires de soins, ainsi qu'un recours accru aux services, peuvent faire augmenter les sommes versées par le régime.

segments.src: - **Prescription drug spending.** Specialty medications and newer, high-cost therapies are a growing share of claims for many plans.
segments.tr: - **Dépenses en médicaments sur ordonnance.** Les médicaments de spécialité et les thérapies récentes et coûteuses représentent une part croissante des demandes de remboursement pour de nombreux régimes.

segments.src: - **Plan renewals and insurer pricing.** Insurers and stop-loss carriers reset rates each year, and employers that self-fund their plans carry the risk of large claims directly.
segments.tr: - **Renouvellements de régimes et tarification des assureurs.** Les assureurs et les assureurs de stop-loss révisent leurs tarifs chaque année, et les employeurs qui autofinancent leurs régimes supportent directement le risque des sinistres importants.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing shifts.** To hold down their own spending, employers may raise employee premium contributions, deductibles, copays, or out-of-pocket maximums, or they may narrow provider networks.
segments.tr: - **Transfert de la participation aux coûts.** Pour limiter leurs propres dépenses, les employeurs peuvent augmenter la part des primes à la charge des salariés, les franchises, les tickets modérateurs ou les plafonds de débours, ou restreindre les réseaux de prestataires.

segments.src: The result is that a plan that looked familiar last year may cost more or work differently this year, even if the plan name has not changed.
segments.tr: Il en résulte qu'un régime qui vous semblait familier l'an dernier peut coûter plus cher ou fonctionner différemment cette année, même si son nom n'a pas changé.

segments.src: ## What Changes You May See
segments.tr: ## Les changements que vous pourriez constater

segments.src: Not every employer makes the same moves, but common adjustments include:
segments.tr: Tous les employeurs ne prennent pas les mêmes mesures, mais les ajustements courants incluent :

segments.src: 1. **Higher payroll deductions.** Your per-paycheck premium may rise, and the increase is often larger for family coverage.
segments.tr: 1. **Retenues sur salaire plus élevées.** Votre prime prélevée à chaque paie peut augmenter, et la hausse est souvent plus importante pour la couverture familiale.

segments.src: 2. **Bigger deductibles.** You may have to pay more out of pocket before the plan starts sharing costs.
segments.tr: 2. **Franchises plus élevées.** Vous devrez peut-être payer davantage de votre poche avant que le régime ne commence à partager les coûts.

segments.src: 3. **Higher out-of-pocket maximums.** This is the most you could pay in a plan year for covered, in-network care.
segments.tr: 3. **Plafonds de débours plus élevés.** Il s'agit du montant maximal que vous pourriez payer au cours d'une année de régime pour des soins couverts et dans le réseau.

segments.src: 4. **Changes to drug coverage.** Look for tier changes, new prior-authorization rules, or different copays and coinsurance.
segments.tr: 4. **Modifications de la couverture des médicaments.** Recherchez les changements de niveaux, les nouvelles règles d'autorisation préalable ou des tickets modérateurs et coassurances différents.

segments.src: 5. **Network changes.** A doctor or hospital you use may move in or out of the network.
segments.tr: 5. **Changements de réseau.** Un médecin ou un hôpital que vous consultez peut entrer dans le réseau ou en sortir.

segments.src: 6. **Fewer plan choices.** Some employers consolidate options or steer people toward high-deductible plans.
segments.tr: 6. **Moins de choix de régimes.** Certains employeurs regroupent les options ou orientent les salariés vers des régimes à franchise élevée.

segments.src: ## What to Compare Side by Side
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut comparer côte à côte

segments.src: Do not judge a plan by the premium alone.
segments.tr: Ne jugez pas un régime uniquement sur la base de la prime.

segments.src: Build a simple comparison for each option:
segments.tr: Établissez une comparaison simple pour chaque option :

segments.src: | What to check | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | Ce qu'il faut vérifier | Pourquoi c'est important |

segments.src: | Per-paycheck premium | Your guaranteed yearly cost, whether or not you use care |
segments.tr: | Prime prélevée à chaque paie | Votre coût annuel garanti, que vous utilisiez ou non des soins |

segments.src: | Deductible (individual and family) | What you pay before most cost-sharing begins |
segments.tr: | Franchise (individuelle et familiale) | Ce que vous payez avant le début de la plupart des participations aux coûts |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case spending for covered in-network care |
segments.tr: | Plafond de débours | Votre dépense maximale pour des soins couverts dans le réseau |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | What you pay for visits, tests, and procedures |
segments.tr: | Tickets modérateurs et coassurance | Ce que vous payez pour les consultations, les examens et les actes |

segments.src: | Prescription tiers | Whether your regular medications are covered and at what cost |
