segments.src: ## Understanding High-Deductible Plans and HSAs
segments.tr: ## Comprendre les régimes à franchise élevée et les HSA

segments.src: Many employers are expanding high-deductible health plans (HDHPs).
segments.tr: De nombreux employeurs développent les régimes de santé à franchise élevée (HDHP).

segments.src: These typically have lower premiums but higher deductibles.
segments.tr: Ceux-ci ont généralement des primes plus basses mais des franchises plus élevées.

segments.src: If you are enrolled in a qualifying HDHP, you may be eligible to contribute to a **health savings account (HSA)**.
segments.tr: Si vous êtes inscrit à un HDHP admissible, vous pourriez être autorisé à cotiser à un **compte d'épargne santé (HSA)**.

segments.src: Key HSA features to know:
segments.tr: Principales caractéristiques du HSA à connaître :

segments.src: - **Tax advantages.** Contributions are generally pre-tax or tax-deductible, growth is tax-free, and withdrawals for qualified medical expenses are tax-free. Review current IRS rules for details.
segments.tr: - **Avantages fiscaux.** Les cotisations sont généralement prélevées avant impôt ou déductibles de l'impôt, la croissance est exonérée d'impôt, et les retraits pour des dépenses médicales admissibles sont exonérés d'impôt. Consultez les règles actuelles de l'IRS pour plus de détails.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits that adjust over time, with higher limits for family coverage and a catch-up amount for people age 55 and older. Check the IRS figures for 2027 before you set your contribution.
segments.tr: - **Plafonds de cotisation.** L'IRS fixe des plafonds annuels qui évoluent avec le temps, avec des plafonds plus élevés pour la couverture familiale et un montant de rattrapage pour les personnes âgées de 55 ans et plus. Vérifiez les chiffres de l'IRS pour 2027 avant de fixer votre cotisation.

segments.src: - **Portability.** The money is yours and stays with you if you change jobs.
segments.tr: - **Portabilité.** L'argent vous appartient et vous reste acquis si vous changez d'emploi.

segments.src: - **Employer contributions.** Some employers add money to your HSA. This can meaningfully reduce the sting of a higher deductible, so compare it carefully.
segments.tr: - **Contributions de l'employeur.** Certains employeurs versent de l'argent sur votre HSA. Cela peut sensiblement atténuer l'impact d'une franchise plus élevée ; comparez-les donc attentivement.

segments.src: - **Eligibility limits.** Having certain other coverage, such as some general-purpose flexible spending accounts or other health coverage, can affect your eligibility. Read the plan rules.
segments.tr: - **Limites d'éligibilité.** Le fait de disposer de certaines autres couvertures, comme certains comptes d'épargne-santé flexibles à usage général ou d'autres couvertures de santé, peut affecter votre éligibilité. Lisez les règles du régime.

segments.src: An HDHP with an HSA can work well for people who are generally healthy and can afford to fund the account.
segments.tr: Un HDHP associé à un HSA peut convenir aux personnes généralement en bonne santé et en mesure d'alimenter ce compte.

segments.src: It can be harder for people who expect frequent care and may struggle to cover a large deductible up front.
segments.tr: Cette formule peut être plus difficile pour les personnes qui prévoient de fréquents soins et qui pourraient avoir du mal à payer d'avance une franchise élevée.

segments.src: ## Other Accounts and Benefits Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## Autres comptes et avantages à considérer

segments.src: - **Flexible spending accounts (FSAs).** Health FSAs let you set aside pre-tax money, but they usually have "use it or lose it" limits with specific deadlines. Check how much can be carried over.
segments.tr: - **Comptes d'épargne-santé flexibles (FSA).** Les FSA santé vous permettent de mettre de côté de l'argent avant impôt, mais ils sont généralement soumis à la règle « utiliser ou perdre » avec des échéances précises. Vérifiez le montant pouvant être reporté.

segments.src: - **Dependent care FSAs.** These can help with eligible child or adult care costs.
segments.tr: - **FSA pour la garde des personnes à charge.** Ils peuvent aider à couvrir les frais admissibles de garde d'enfants ou d'adultes.

segments.src: - **Telehealth and virtual care.** Some plans offer low-cost or free virtual visits that can reduce out-of-pocket spending for minor issues.
segments.tr: - **Télésanté et soins virtuels.** Certains régimes proposent des consultations virtuelles à faible coût ou gratuites, qui peuvent réduire vos dépenses à charge pour des problèmes mineurs.

segments.src: - **Mental health coverage.** Compare copays, visit limits, and whether therapists you use are in-network.
segments.tr: - **Couverture de la santé mentale.** Comparez les tickets modérateurs, les limites de consultations et si les thérapeutes que vous consultez font partie du réseau.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent rules.** Some employers add surcharges when a spouse has access to coverage elsewhere. Look for new surcharges or eligibility changes.
segments.tr: - **Règles relatives au conjoint et aux personnes à charge.** Certains employeurs appliquent des surprimes lorsque le conjoint a accès à une couverture ailleurs. Recherchez les nouvelles surprimes ou les changements d'éligibilité.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## Démarches pratiques avant la date limite

segments.src: 1. **Mark the dates.** Open enrollment windows are short, and missing one can lock you into your current choices for a year, outside of qualifying life events.
segments.tr: 1. **Notez les dates.** Les périodes d'inscription annuelle sont courtes, et en manquer une peut vous enfermer dans vos choix actuels pendant un an, en dehors des événements de vie ouvrant droit à modification.

segments.src: 2. **Read the summary of benefits and coverage.** Employers must provide standardized summaries that make plans easier to compare.
segments.tr: 2. **Lisez le résumé des garanties et de la couverture.** Les employeurs doivent fournir des résumés standardisés qui facilitent la comparaison des régimes.

segments.src: 3. **Check your doctors and prescriptions.** Use the plan's provider directory and drug list, and confirm with your providers' offices when possible.
segments.tr: 3. **Vérifiez vos médecins et vos ordonnances.** Utilisez l'annuaire des prestataires et la liste des médicaments du régime, et confirmez auprès des cabinets de vos prestataires lorsque c'est possible.

segments.src: 4. **Review last year's spending.** Your past claims and explanation-of-benefits statements are a useful guide to what you may need.
segments.tr: 4. **Examinez les dépenses de l'an dernier.** Vos demandes de remboursement passées et vos relevés de prestations sont un guide utile pour savoir ce dont vous pourriez avoir besoin.

segments.src: 5. **Look at the whole picture.** Consider premiums, deductibles, HSA or FSA options, and employer contributions together.
segments.tr: 5. **Considérez l'ensemble.** Tenez compte ensemble des primes, des franchises, des options HSA ou FSA et des contributions de l'employeur.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help.** Your HR or benefits team, plan portal, or benefits hotline can answer questions about the specifics.
segments.tr: 6. **Demandez de l'aide.** Votre service RH ou d'avantages sociaux, le portail du régime ou la ligne d'assistance peuvent répondre à vos questions spécifiques.

segments.src: 7. **Think about alternatives.** If you have access to a spouse's plan or are eligible for other coverage, compare it with your own employer's options. Marketplace coverage may be an option in some situations, so review eligibility rules.
segments.tr: 7. **Pensez aux alternatives.** Si vous avez accès au régime de votre conjoint ou si vous êtes admissible à une autre couverture, comparez-la aux options de votre propre employeur. La couverture via une marketplace peut être une option dans certaines situations ; examinez donc les règles d'éligibilité.

segments.src: 8. **Confirm your choices.** Save your confirmation and review your first paycheck to make sure the deductions match what you selected.
segments.tr: 8. **Confirmez vos choix.** Conservez votre confirmation et vérifiez votre première fiche de paie pour vous assurer que les retenues correspondent à vos choix.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En bref

segments.src: Rising health care and drug costs are shaping the benefits offered at many workplaces, and employees are often asked to cover more of the expense through premiums and deductibles.
segments.tr: La hausse des coûts des soins de santé et des médicaments façonne les avantages proposés dans de nombreuses entreprises, et les salariés sont souvent appelés à prendre en charge une part plus importante de la dépense via les primes et les franchises.

segments.src: The best response is to compare plans on total expected cost and fit with your health needs, not just the monthly premium.
segments.tr: La meilleure réponse consiste à comparer les régimes sur le coût total attendu et leur adéquation à vos besoins de santé, et non sur la seule prime mensuelle.

segments.src: Taking an hour with your benefits materials now can help you avoid surprises later in the year.
segments.tr: Consacrer une heure à vos documents d'avantages sociaux dès maintenant peut vous aider à éviter les mauvaises surprises plus tard dans l'année.

segments.src: *Because plan rules, tax limits, and eligibility requirements change, verify the details with your employer, your plan administrator, and official sources such as the IRS and Healthcare.gov before making decisions.*
segments.tr: *Les règles des régimes, les plafonds fiscaux et les conditions d'éligibilité évoluant, vérifiez les détails auprès de votre employeur, de votre gestionnaire de régime et de sources officielles telles que l'IRS et Healthcare.gov avant de prendre toute décision.*

pt.title: Planos de Saúde Empresariais 2027: Por que o Período de Inscrição Costuma Significar Prêmios Mais Altos e Franquias Maiores

segments.src: As open enrollment season begins at many workplaces, a familiar pattern is showing up in benefits packets: the cost of coverage is rising, and more of that cost is landing on employees.
segments.tr: Quando o período de inscrição aberta começa em muitos locais de trabalho, um padrão conhecido aparece nos pacotes de benefícios: o custo da cobertura está subindo, e uma parcela maior desse custo recai sobre os funcionários.

segments.src: Surveys from benefits consultants and industry groups have pointed to continued increases in medical and prescription drug spending, and many employers say they are adjusting plan designs to manage the bill.
segments.tr: Pesquisas de consultorias de benefícios e de entidades do setor apontam aumentos contínuos nos gastos com assistência médica e medicamentos de prescrição, e muitos empregadores dizem que estão ajustando o desenho dos planos para administrar a conta.

segments.src: This guide explains why premiums and deductibles tend to climb, what to compare when you review your options for 2027, and how to avoid common mistakes before your enrollment window closes.
segments.tr: Este guia explica por que os prêmios e as franquias tendem a subir, o que comparar ao avaliar suas opções para 2027 e como evitar erros comuns antes do encerramento do período de inscrição.

segments.src: ## Why Costs Keep Rising
segments.tr: ## Por que os custos continuam subindo

segments.src: Several forces tend to push employer plan costs up at the same time:
segments.tr: Várias forças tendem a pressionar para cima os custos dos planos empresariais ao mesmo tempo:

segments.src: - **Higher medical prices and use of care.** Hospital and provider costs, along with greater use of services, can raise what a plan pays out.
segments.tr: - **Preços mais altos de assistência médica e maior uso de serviços.** Os custos de hospitais e prestadores, somados ao maior uso de serviços, podem elevar o que o plano paga.

segments.src: - **Prescription drug spending.** Specialty medications and newer, high-cost therapies are a growing share of claims for many plans.
segments.tr: - **Gastos com medicamentos de prescrição.** Medicamentos especializados e terapias novas e de alto custo representam uma fatia crescente das despesas de muitos planos.

segments.src: - **Plan renewals and insurer pricing.** Insurers and stop-loss carriers reset rates each year, and employers that self-fund their plans carry the risk of large claims directly.
segments.tr: - **Renovações de planos e precificação das seguradoras.** Seguradoras e operadoras de stop-loss reajustam as taxas a cada ano, e empregadores que financiam o próprio plano assumem diretamente o risco de sinistros de grande valor.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing shifts.** To hold down their own spending, employers may raise employee premium contributions, deductibles, copays, or out-of-pocket maximums, or they may narrow provider networks.
segments.tr: - **Mudanças na divisão de custos.** Para conter os próprios gastos, os empregadores podem aumentar a contribuição dos funcionários no prêmio, as franquias, as coparticipações ou o limite máximo de desembolso, ou podem restringir as redes de prestadores.

segments.src: The result is that a plan that looked familiar last year may cost more or work differently this year, even if the plan name has not changed.
segments.tr: O resultado é que um plano que parecia familiar no ano passado pode custar mais ou funcionar de forma diferente este ano, mesmo que o nome do plano não tenha mudado.

segments.src: ## What Changes You May See
segments.tr: ## Mudanças que você pode notar

segments.src: Not every employer makes the same moves, but common adjustments include:
segments.tr: Nem todo empregador toma as mesmas medidas, mas os ajustes mais comuns incluem:

segments.src: 1. **Higher payroll deductions.** Your per-paycheck premium may rise, and the increase is often larger for family coverage.
segments.tr: 1. **Descontos em folha mais altos.** Seu prêmio por contracheque pode subir, e o aumento costuma ser maior para a cobertura familiar.

segments.src: 2. **Bigger deductibles.** You may have to pay more out of pocket before the plan starts sharing costs.
segments.tr: 2. **Franquias maiores.** Você pode ter que pagar mais do próprio bolso antes que o plano comece a dividir os custos.

segments.src: 3. **Higher out-of-pocket maximums.** This is the most you could pay in a plan year for covered, in-network care.
segments.tr: 3. **Limites máximos de desembolso mais altos.** Este é o valor máximo que você pode pagar em um ano do plano por atendimentos cobertos na rede credenciada.

segments.src: 4. **Changes to drug coverage.** Look for tier changes, new prior-authorization rules, or different copays and coinsurance.
segments.tr: 4. **Mudanças na cobertura de medicamentos.** Fique atento a mudanças de faixa, novas regras de autorização prévia e diferentes coparticipações ou coseguros.

segments.src: 5. **Network changes.** A doctor or hospital you use may move in or out of the network.
segments.tr: 5. **Mudanças na rede.** Um médico ou hospital que você usa pode entrar ou sair da rede credenciada.

segments.src: 6. **Fewer plan choices.** Some employers consolidate options or steer people toward high-deductible plans.
segments.tr: 6. **Menos opções de plano.** Alguns empregadores unificam as opções ou direcionam as pessoas para planos de franquia alta.

segments.tr: ## O que comparar lado a lado

segments.src: 8. **Confirm your choices.** Save your confirmation and review your first paycheck to make sure the deductions match what you selected.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: Rising health care and drug costs are shaping the benefits offered at many workplaces, and employees are often asked to cover more of the expense through premiums and deductibles.
segments.tr: O aumento dos custos com assistência médica e medicamentos está moldando os benefícios oferecidos em muitos locais de trabalho, e os funcionários são frequentemente chamados a cobrir uma parcela maior da despesa por meio de prêmios e franquias.

segments.src: The best response is to compare plans on total expected cost and fit with your health needs, not just the monthly premium.
segments.tr: A melhor resposta é comparar os planos pelo custo total esperado e pela adequação às suas necessidades de saúde, e não apenas pelo prêmio mensal.

segments.src: Taking an hour with your benefits materials now can help you avoid surprises later in the year.
segments.tr: Dedicar uma hora agora aos materiais de benefícios pode ajudar a evitar surpresas ao longo do ano.

segments.src: *Because plan rules, tax limits, and eligibility requirements change, verify the details with your employer, your plan administrator, and official sources such as the IRS and Healthcare.gov before making decisions.*

in.title: Paket Kesehatan Pemberi Kerja 2027: Mengapa Open Enrollment Sering Berarti Premi Lebih Tinggi dan Deductible Lebih Besar

segments.src: As open enrollment season begins at many workplaces, a familiar pattern is showing up in benefits packets: the cost of coverage is rising, and more of that cost is landing on employees.
segments.tr: Ketika masa pendaftaran (open enrollment) dimulai di banyak tempat kerja, pola yang sudah familiar mulai terlihat di paket tunjangan: biaya asuransi naik, dan semakin banyak biaya itu dibebankan kepada karyawan.

segments.src: Surveys from benefits consultants and industry groups have pointed to continued increases in medical and prescription drug spending, and many employers say they are adjusting plan designs to manage the bill.
segments.tr: Survei dari konsultan tunjangan dan asosiasi industri menunjukkan kenaikan berkelanjutan pada belanja medis dan obat resep, dan banyak pemberi kerja mengatakan mereka menyesuaikan desain paket untuk mengendalikan tagihan.

segments.src: This guide explains why premiums and deductibles tend to climb, what to compare when you review your options for 2027, and how to avoid common mistakes before your enrollment window closes.
segments.tr: Panduan ini menjelaskan mengapa premi dan deductible cenderung naik, hal apa saja yang perlu dibandingkan saat meninjau pilihan untuk 2027, dan cara menghindari kesalahan umum sebelum masa pendaftaran berakhir.

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is for general information only. It is not medical, tax, legal, or financial advice. Plan details vary widely, so always check your own employer's official materials.
segments.tr: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini hanya untuk informasi umum. Ini bukan nasihat medis, pajak, hukum, atau keuangan. Detail paket sangat bervariasi, jadi selalu periksa materi resmi dari pemberi kerja Anda.

segments.src: ## Why Costs Keep Rising
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Biaya Terus Naik

segments.src: Several forces tend to push employer plan costs up at the same time:
segments.tr: Beberapa faktor cenderung mendorong biaya paket pemberi kerja naik secara bersamaan:

segments.src: - **Higher medical prices and use of care.** Hospital and provider costs, along with greater use of services, can raise what a plan pays out.
segments.tr: - **Harga medis yang lebih tinggi dan penggunaan layanan.** Biaya rumah sakit dan penyedia layanan, ditambah meningkatnya penggunaan layanan, dapat menaikkan jumlah yang dibayarkan paket.

segments.src: - **Prescription drug spending.** Specialty medications and newer, high-cost therapies are a growing share of claims for many plans.
segments.tr: - **Belanja obat resep.** Obat spesialis dan terapi baru yang mahal menjadi porsi klaim yang semakin besar bagi banyak paket.

segments.src: - **Plan renewals and insurer pricing.** Insurers and stop-loss carriers reset rates each year, and employers that self-fund their plans carry the risk of large claims directly.
segments.tr: - **Pembaruan paket dan harga asuransi.** Perusahaan asuransi dan penanggung stop-loss menetapkan ulang tarif setiap tahun, dan pemberi kerja yang mendanai sendiri paketnya menanggung langsung risiko klaim besar.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing shifts.** To hold down their own spending, employers may raise employee premium contributions, deductibles, copays, or out-of-pocket maximums, or they may narrow provider networks.
segments.tr: - **Pergeseran pembagian biaya.** Untuk menekan pengeluaran mereka sendiri, pemberi kerja mungkin menaikkan kontribusi premi karyawan, deductible, copay, atau batas maksimum out-of-pocket, atau mempersempit jaringan penyedia layanan.

segments.src: The result is that a plan that looked familiar last year may cost more or work differently this year, even if the plan name has not changed.
segments.tr: Akibatnya, paket yang tampak sama seperti tahun lalu bisa menjadi lebih mahal atau bekerja berbeda tahun ini, meskipun nama paketnya tidak berubah.

segments.src: ## What Changes You May See
segments.tr: ## Perubahan yang Mungkin Anda Temui

segments.src: Not every employer makes the same moves, but common adjustments include:
segments.tr: Tidak semua pemberi kerja melakukan langkah yang sama, tetapi penyesuaian umum meliputi:

segments.src: 1. **Higher payroll deductions.** Your per-paycheck premium may rise, and the increase is often larger for family coverage.
segments.tr: 1. **Potongan gaji yang lebih tinggi.** Premi per gaji Anda mungkin naik, dan kenaikannya sering lebih besar untuk paket keluarga.

segments.src: 2. **Bigger deductibles.** You may have to pay more out of pocket before the plan starts sharing costs.
segments.tr: 2. **Deductible yang lebih besar.** Anda mungkin harus membayar lebih banyak dari kantong sendiri sebelum paket mulai menanggung biaya.

segments.src: 3. **Higher out-of-pocket maximums.** This is the most you could pay in a plan year for covered, in-network care.
segments.tr: 3. **Batas maksimum out-of-pocket yang lebih tinggi.** Ini adalah jumlah maksimum yang bisa Anda bayar dalam satu tahun paket untuk perawatan yang ditanggung dan berada dalam jaringan.

segments.src: 4. **Changes to drug coverage.** Look for tier changes, new prior-authorization rules, or different copays and coinsurance.
segments.tr: 4. **Perubahan cakupan obat.** Perhatikan perubahan tier, aturan prior-authorization baru, atau copay dan coinsurance yang berbeda.

segments.src: 5. **Network changes.** A doctor or hospital you use may move in or out of the network.
segments.tr: 5. **Perubahan jaringan.** Dokter atau rumah sakit yang Anda gunakan mungkin keluar atau masuk ke dalam jaringan.

segments.src: 6. **Fewer plan choices.** Some employers consolidate options or steer people toward high-deductible plans.
segments.tr: 6. **Pilihan paket yang lebih sedikit.** Beberapa pemberi kerja menggabungkan opsi atau mengarahkan karyawan ke paket deductible tinggi.

segments.src: ## What to Compare Side by Side
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dibandingkan Berdampingan

segments.src: Do not judge a plan by the premium alone.
segments.tr: Jangan menilai paket hanya dari premi.

segments.src: Build a simple comparison for each option:
segments.tr: Buat perbandingan sederhana untuk setiap opsi:

segments.src: | What to check | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | Yang diperiksa | Mengapa penting |

segments.src: | Per-paycheck premium | Your guaranteed yearly cost, whether or not you use care |
segments.tr: | Premi per gaji | Biaya tahunan yang pasti, baik Anda menggunakan layanan maupun tidak |

segments.src: | Deductible (individual and family) | What you pay before most cost-sharing begins |
segments.tr: | Deductible (individu dan keluarga) | Yang harus Anda bayar sebelum sebagian besar pembagian biaya dimulai |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case spending for covered in-network care |
segments.tr: | Batas maksimum out-of-pocket | Pengeluaran terburuk Anda untuk perawatan yang ditanggung dan berada dalam jaringan |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | What you pay for visits, tests, and procedures |
segments.tr: | Copay dan coinsurance | Yang Anda bayar untuk kunjungan, tes, dan prosedur |

segments.src: | Prescription tiers | Whether your regular medications are covered and at what cost |
segments.tr: | Tier obat resep | Apakah obat rutin Anda ditanggung dan dengan biaya berapa |

segments.src: | Network | Whether your doctors, specialists, and hospital are in-network |
segments.tr: | Jaringan | Apakah dokter, spesialis, dan rumah sakit Anda termasuk dalam jaringan |

segments.src: | Employer HSA or HRA contribution | Free money that can offset a higher deductible |
segments.tr: | Kontribusi HSA atau HRA dari pemberi kerja | Uang gratis yang dapat mengimbangi deductible yang lebih tinggi |

segments.src: A helpful exercise: estimate your total yearly cost for each plan in two scenarios.
segments.tr: Latihan yang berguna: perkirakan total biaya tahunan Anda untuk setiap paket dalam dua skenario.

segments.src: First, a **low-use year** (routine checkups and a few prescriptions).
segments.tr: Pertama, **tahun dengan penggunaan rendah** (pemeriksaan rutin dan beberapa resep).

segments.src: Second, a **high-use year** (a surgery, an emergency room visit, or a new ongoing treatment).
segments.tr: Kedua, **tahun dengan penggunaan tinggi** (operasi, kunjungan UGD, atau pengobatan berkelanjutan yang baru).

segments.src: Add the annual premiums to your likely out-of-pocket costs in each case.
segments.tr: Tambahkan premi tahunan ke perkiraan biaya out-of-pocket Anda dalam setiap kasus.

segments.src: The cheapest premium is not always the cheapest plan overall.
segments.tr: Premi termurah belum tentu paket termurah secara keseluruhan.

segments.src: ## Understanding High-Deductible Plans and HSAs
segments.tr: ## Memahami Paket Deductible Tinggi dan HSA

segments.src: Many employers are expanding high-deductible health plans (HDHPs).
segments.tr: Banyak pemberi kerja memperluas paket asuransi kesehatan deductible tinggi (HDHP).

segments.src: These typically have lower premiums but higher deductibles.
segments.tr: Paket ini biasanya memiliki premi yang lebih rendah tetapi deductible yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: If you are enrolled in a qualifying HDHP, you may be eligible to contribute to a **health savings account (HSA)**.
segments.tr: Jika Anda terdaftar dalam HDHP yang memenuhi syarat, Anda mungkin dapat berkontribusi ke **health savings account (HSA)**.

segments.src: Key HSA features to know:
segments.tr: Fitur HSA utama yang perlu diketahui:

segments.src: - **Tax advantages.** Contributions are generally pre-tax or tax-deductible, growth is tax-free, and withdrawals for qualified medical expenses are tax-free. Review current IRS rules for details.
segments.tr: - **Keuntungan pajak.** Kontribusi umumnya dibayar sebelum pajak atau dapat dikurangkan dari pajak, pertumbuhan dananya bebas pajak, dan penarikan untuk biaya medis yang memenuhi syarat bebas pajak. Tinjau aturan IRS terkini untuk detailnya.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits that adjust over time, with higher limits for family coverage and a catch-up amount for people age 55 and older. Check the IRS figures for 2027 before you set your contribution.
segments.tr: - **Batas kontribusi.** IRS menetapkan batas tahunan yang berubah dari waktu ke waktu, dengan batas lebih tinggi untuk paket keluarga dan jumlah catch-up bagi orang berusia 55 tahun ke atas. Periksa angka IRS untuk 2027 sebelum Anda menentukan kontribusi.

segments.src: - **Portability.** The money is yours and stays with you if you change jobs.
segments.tr: - **Portabilitas.** Dana itu milik Anda dan tetap bersama Anda jika Anda berganti pekerjaan.

segments.src: - **Employer contributions.** Some employers add money to your HSA. This can meaningfully reduce the sting of a higher deductible, so compare it carefully.
segments.tr: - **Kontribusi pemberi kerja.** Beberapa pemberi kerja menambahkan uang ke HSA Anda. Ini dapat secara signifikan mengurangi beban deductible yang lebih tinggi, jadi bandingkan dengan cermat.

segments.src: - **Eligibility limits.** Having certain other coverage, such as some general-purpose flexible spending accounts or other health coverage, can affect your eligibility. Read the plan rules.
segments.tr: - **Batas kelayakan.** Memiliki jenis cakupan lain tertentu, seperti beberapa flexible spending account (FSA) serbaguna atau cakupan kesehatan lainnya, dapat memengaruhi kelayakan Anda. Baca aturan paketnya.

segments.src: An HDHP with an HSA can work well for people who are generally healthy and can afford to fund the account.
segments.tr: HDHP dengan HSA dapat cocok bagi orang yang umumnya sehat dan mampu mendanai rekening tersebut.

segments.src: It can be harder for people who expect frequent care and may struggle to cover a large deductible up front.
segments.tr: Ini bisa lebih sulit bagi orang yang sering membutuhkan perawatan dan mungkin kesulitan menutup deductible besar di awal.

segments.src: ## Other Accounts and Benefits Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## Akun dan Tunjangan Lain yang Layak Diperhatikan

segments.src: - **Flexible spending accounts (FSAs).** Health FSAs let you set aside pre-tax money, but they usually have "use it or lose it" limits with specific deadlines. Check how much can be carried over.
segments.tr: - **Flexible spending account (FSA).** FSA kesehatan memungkinkan Anda menyisihkan uang sebelum pajak, tetapi biasanya ada batas "pakai atau hangus" dengan tenggat waktu tertentu. Periksa berapa banyak yang dapat dibawa ke periode berikutnya.

segments.src: - **Dependent care FSAs.** These can help with eligible child or adult care costs.
segments.tr: - **FSA perawatan tanggungan.** Ini dapat membantu biaya perawatan anak atau orang dewasa yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: - **Telehealth and virtual care.** Some plans offer low-cost or free virtual visits that can reduce out-of-pocket spending for minor issues.
segments.tr: - **Telehealth dan perawatan virtual.** Beberapa paket menawarkan kunjungan virtual berbiaya rendah atau gratis yang dapat mengurangi pengeluaran out-of-pocket untuk masalah ringan.

segments.src: - **Mental health coverage.** Compare copays, visit limits, and whether therapists you use are in-network.
segments.tr: - **Cakupan kesehatan mental.** Bandingkan copay, batas kunjungan, dan apakah terapis yang Anda gunakan termasuk dalam jaringan.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent rules.** Some employers add surcharges when a spouse has access to coverage elsewhere. Look for new surcharges or eligibility changes.
segments.tr: - **Aturan pasangan dan tanggungan.** Beberapa pemberi kerja menambahkan surcharge jika pasangan memiliki akses cakupan di tempat lain. Perhatikan surcharge baru atau perubahan kelayakan.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## Langkah Praktis Sebelum Tenggat

segments.src: 1. **Mark the dates.** Open enrollment windows are short, and missing one can lock you into your current choices for a year, outside of qualifying life events.
segments.tr: 1. **Tandai tanggalnya.** Periode open enrollment singkat, dan melewatkannya dapat mengunci pilihan Anda saat ini selama setahun, di luar peristiwa kehidupan yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: 2. **Read the summary of benefits and coverage.** Employers must provide standardized summaries that make plans easier to compare.
segments.tr: 2. **Baca ringkasan manfaat dan cakupan (summary of benefits and coverage).** Pemberi kerja wajib menyediakan ringkasan standar yang memudahkan perbandingan paket.

segments.src: 3. **Check your doctors and prescriptions.** Use the plan's provider directory and drug list, and confirm with your providers' offices when possible.
segments.tr: 3. **Periksa dokter dan resep Anda.** Gunakan direktori penyedia dan daftar obat dari paket, dan konfirmasi dengan kantor penyedia Anda jika memungkinkan.

segments.src: 4. **Review last year's spending.** Your past claims and explanation-of-benefits statements are a useful guide to what you may need.
segments.tr: 4. **Tinjau pengeluaran tahun lalu.** Klaim masa lalu dan pernyataan explanation-of-benefits Anda adalah panduan yang berguna untuk kebutuhan Anda.

segments.src: 5. **Look at the whole picture.** Consider premiums, deductibles, HSA or FSA options, and employer contributions together.
segments.tr: 5. **Lihat gambaran besarnya.** Pertimbangkan premi, deductible, opsi HSA atau FSA, dan kontribusi pemberi kerja secara bersamaan.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help.** Your HR or benefits team, plan portal, or benefits hotline can answer questions about the specifics.
segments.tr: 6. **Minta bantuan.** Tim HR atau tunjangan, portal paket, atau hotline tunjangan dapat menjawab pertanyaan tentang detailnya.

segments.src: 7. **Think about alternatives.** If you have access to a spouse's plan or are eligible for other coverage, compare it with your own employer's options. Marketplace coverage may be an option in some situations, so review eligibility rules.
segments.tr: 7. **Pertimbangkan alternatif.** Jika Anda memiliki akses ke paket pasangan atau memenuhi syarat untuk cakupan lain, bandingkan dengan opsi pemberi kerja Anda sendiri. Cakupan marketplace mungkin menjadi pilihan dalam beberapa situasi, jadi tinjau aturan kelayakannya.

segments.src: 8. **Confirm your choices.** Save your confirmation and review your first paycheck to make sure the deductions match what you selected.
segments.tr: 8. **Konfirmasi pilihan Anda.** Simpan konfirmasi Anda dan tinjau gaji pertama Anda untuk memastikan potongannya sesuai dengan yang Anda pilih.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: Rising health care and drug costs are shaping the benefits offered at many workplaces, and employees are often asked to cover more of the expense through premiums and deductibles.
segments.tr: Kenaikan biaya layanan kesehatan dan obat membentuk tunjangan yang ditawarkan di banyak tempat kerja, dan karyawan sering diminta menanggung lebih banyak biaya melalui premi dan deductible.

segments.src: The best response is to compare plans on total expected cost and fit with your health needs, not just the monthly premium.
segments.tr: Respons terbaik adalah membandingkan paket berdasarkan perkiraan total biaya dan kesesuaiannya dengan kebutuhan kesehatan Anda, bukan hanya premi bulanan.

segments.src: Taking an hour with your benefits materials now can help you avoid surprises later in the year.
segments.tr: Meluangkan satu jam untuk materi tunjangan Anda sekarang dapat membantu Anda menghindari kejutan di kemudian hari dalam setahun.

segments.src: *Because plan rules, tax limits, and eligibility requirements change, verify the details with your employer, your plan administrator, and official sources such as the IRS and Healthcare.gov before making decisions.*
segments.tr: *Karena aturan paket, batas pajak, dan persyaratan kelayakan berubah, verifikasi detailnya dengan pemberi kerja Anda, administrator paket, dan sumber resmi seperti IRS dan Healthcare.gov sebelum membuat keputusan.*

segments.src: ## What Changes You May See

segments.src: 3. **Higher out-of-pocket maximums.** This is the most you could pay in a plan year for covered, in-network care.
segments.tr: 3. **自己負担上限額の引き上げ。** 保険適用となり、ネットワーク内で受けた医療について、1年間に支払う可能性のある最大額です。

segments.src: 4. **Changes to drug coverage.** Look for tier changes, new prior-authorization rules, or different copays and coinsurance.
segments.tr: 4. **薬剤保険の変更。** ティア（区分）の変更、新たな事前承認ルール、窓口負担やコインシュランスの違いに注意してください。

segments.src: 5. **Network changes.** A doctor or hospital you use may move in or out of the network.
segments.tr: 5. **ネットワークの変更。** 利用している医師や病院がネットワーク内外に移動する場合があります。

segments.src: 6. **Fewer plan choices.** Some employers consolidate options or steer people toward high-deductible plans.
segments.tr: 6. **選択できるプランの減少。** 一部の雇用主は選択肢を統合したり、従業員を高額免責型プラン（HDHP）へ誘導したりします。

segments.src: ## What to Compare Side by Side
segments.tr: ## 並べて比較すべき項目

segments.src: Do not judge a plan by the premium alone.
segments.tr: 保険料だけでプランを判断しないでください。

segments.src: Build a simple comparison for each option:
segments.tr: 選択肢ごとに簡単な比較表を作成してください：

segments.src: | What to check | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | 確認項目 | 重要な理由 |

segments.src: | Per-paycheck premium | Your guaranteed yearly cost, whether or not you use care |
segments.tr: | 給与ごとの保険料 | 医療を利用したかどうかにかかわらず、1年間に確実に支払う費用 |

segments.src: | Deductible (individual and family) | What you pay before most cost-sharing begins |
segments.tr: | 免責額（個人・家族） | 大半の費用分担が始まる前に支払う金額 |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case spending for covered in-network care |
segments.tr: | 自己負担上限額 | ネットワーク内で保険適用となる医療に対する最悪の場合の支出 |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | What you pay for visits, tests, and procedures |
segments.tr: | 窓口負担（コペイ）とコインシュランス | 受診、検査、処置ごとに支払う金額 |

segments.src: | Prescription tiers | Whether your regular medications are covered and at what cost |
segments.tr: | 処方薬の区分 | 普段服用している薬が保険適用になるか、またその費用はいくらか |

segments.src: | Network | Whether your doctors, specialists, and hospital are in-network |
segments.tr: | ネットワーク | かかりつけ医、専門医、病院がネットワーク内にあるか |

segments.src: | Employer HSA or HRA contribution | Free money that can offset a higher deductible |
segments.tr: | 雇用主によるHSAまたはHRAへの拠出 | 免責額の上昇を相殺できる、いわば「もらえるお金」 |

segments.src: A helpful exercise: estimate your total yearly cost for each plan in two scenarios.
segments.tr: 役立つ方法として、各プランの年間総費用を2つのシナリオで見積もることをおすすめします。

segments.src: First, a **low-use year** (routine checkups and a few prescriptions).
segments.tr: まず、**受診が少ない年**（定期検診と数種類の処方薬のみ）。

segments.src: Second, a **high-use year** (a surgery, an emergency room visit, or a new ongoing treatment).
segments.tr: 次に、**受診が多い年**（手術、救急外来の受診、または新たな継続治療）。

segments.src: Add the annual premiums to your likely out-of-pocket costs in each case.
segments.tr: それぞれのケースで、年間保険料に想定される自己負担額を加算してください。

segments.src: The cheapest premium is not always the cheapest plan overall.
segments.tr: 最も保険料が安いプランが、必ずしも総合的に最も安いプランとは限りません。

segments.src: ## Understanding High-Deductible Plans and HSAs
segments.tr: ## 高額免責型プラン（HDHP）とHSAについて

segments.src: Many employers are expanding high-deductible health plans (HDHPs).
segments.tr: 多くの雇用主が高額免責型医療保険（HDHP）を拡大しています。

segments.src: These typically have lower premiums but higher deductibles.
segments.tr: これらは通常、保険料は安いものの免責額が高く設定されています。

segments.src: If you are enrolled in a qualifying HDHP, you may be eligible to contribute to a **health savings account (HSA)**.
segments.tr: 適格なHDHPに加入している場合、**医療貯蓄口座（HSA）**への拠出の対象となることがあります。

segments.src: Key HSA features to know:
segments.tr: HSAの主な特徴は次のとおりです：

segments.src: - **Tax advantages.** Contributions are generally pre-tax or tax-deductible, growth is tax-free, and withdrawals for qualified medical expenses are tax-free. Review current IRS rules for details.
segments.tr: - **税制上の優遇。** 拠出金は一般的に税引前または所得控除の対象となり、運用益は非課税で、適格な医療費への支払いも非課税です。詳細は現行の米国内国歳入庁（IRS）の規則をご確認ください。

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits that adjust over time, with higher limits for family coverage and a catch-up amount for people age 55 and older. Check the IRS figures for 2027 before you set your contribution.
segments.tr: - **拠出限度額。** IRSが年間の上限額を定めており、この額は時間とともに調整されます。家族向け保険の方が上限額は高く、55歳以上の人にはキャッチアップ拠出額があります。拠出額を決める前に、2027年のIRSの数値をご確認ください。

segments.src: - **Portability.** The money is yours and stays with you if you change jobs.
segments.tr: - **ポータビリティ。** このお金はあなたのものであり、転職しても手元に残ります。

segments.src: - **Employer contributions.** Some employers add money to your HSA. This can meaningfully reduce the sting of a higher deductible, so compare it carefully.
segments.tr: - **雇用主による拠出。** 雇用主がHSAに資金を追加する場合があります。これは免責額が高いことによる負担を大きく和らげることができるため、慎重に比較してください。

segments.src: - **Eligibility limits.** Having certain other coverage, such as some general-purpose flexible spending accounts or other health coverage, can affect your eligibility. Read the plan rules.
segments.tr: - **加入資格の制限。** 一部の汎用フレキシブル・スペンディング・アカウント（FSA）や他の医療保険など、特定の他の保険に加入していると、加入資格に影響する場合があります。プランの規則を必ずお読みください。

segments.src: An HDHP with an HSA can work well for people who are generally healthy and can afford to fund the account.
segments.tr: HSA付きのHDHPは、全般的に健康で、口座への資金拠出を十分に負担できる人にとっては有効な選択肢になり得ます。

segments.src: It can be harder for people who expect frequent care and may struggle to cover a large deductible up front.
segments.tr: 一方、頻繁に受診することが予想される人や、高額な免責額を前払いするのが難しい人には、負担が大きくなる場合があります。

segments.src: ## Other Accounts and Benefits Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## 検討する価値のある他の口座と福利厚生

segments.src: - **Flexible spending accounts (FSAs).** Health FSAs let you set aside pre-tax money, but they usually have "use it or lose it" limits with specific deadlines. Check how much can be carried over.
segments.tr: - **フレキシブル・スペンディング・アカウント（FSA）。** ヘルスFSAでは税引前の資金を積み立てられますが、通常は「使わなければ失効する」ルールがあり、期限が決められています。翌年への繰越可能額を確認してください。

segments.src: - **Dependent care FSAs.** These can help with eligible child or adult care costs.
segments.tr: - **扶養者ケアFSA。** 対象となる子どもや成人の介護費用に利用できる場合があります。

segments.src: - **Telehealth and virtual care.** Some plans offer low-cost or free virtual visits that can reduce out-of-pocket spending for minor issues.
segments.tr: - **遠隔医療・オンライン診療。** 低額または無料のオンライン診療を提供しているプランもあり、軽い症状の場合は自己負担を抑えられます。

segments.src: - **Mental health coverage.** Compare copays, visit limits, and whether therapists you use are in-network.
segments.tr: - **メンタルヘルス保険。** 窓口負担、受診回数の上限、利用しているセラピストがネットワーク内かどうかを比較してください。

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent rules.** Some employers add surcharges when a spouse has access to coverage elsewhere. Look for new surcharges or eligibility changes.
segments.tr: - **配偶者・扶養者に関するルール。** 配偶者が他で保険に加入できる場合、追加料金を課す雇用主もあります。新たな追加料金や加入資格の変更がないか確認してください。

segments.src: ## Practical Steps Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## 締め切り前の実践的なステップ

segments.src: 1. **Mark the dates.** Open enrollment windows are short, and missing one can lock you into your current choices for a year, outside of qualifying life events.
segments.tr: 1. **日付を確認する。** オープン・エンロールメントの期間は短く、期限を逃すと、適格なライフイベントがない限り、1年間は現在の選択が固定される可能性があります。

segments.src: 2. **Read the summary of benefits and coverage.** Employers must provide standardized summaries that make plans easier to compare.
segments.tr: 2. **給付・補償概要書を読む。** 雇用主は、プランを比較しやすくするための標準化された概要書を提供しなければなりません。

segments.src: 3. **Check your doctors and prescriptions.** Use the plan's provider directory and drug list, and confirm with your providers' offices when possible.
segments.tr: 3. **かかりつけ医と処方薬を確認する。** プランの医療機関検索や薬剤リストを使い、可能であれば医療機関に直接確認してください。

segments.src: 4. **Review last year's spending.** Your past claims and explanation-of-benefits statements are a useful guide to what you may need.
segments.tr: 4. **昨年の支出を見直す。** 過去の請求内容や給付明細書（EOB）は、今後必要になるものを知るための有用な指針になります。

segments.src: 5. **Look at the whole picture.** Consider premiums, deductibles, HSA or FSA options, and employer contributions together.
segments.tr: 5. **全体像で判断する。** 保険料、免責額、HSAまたはFSAの選択肢、雇用主による拠出をまとめて検討してください。

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help.** Your HR or benefits team, plan portal, or benefits hotline can answer questions about the specifics.
segments.tr: 6. **助けを求める。** 人事（HR）や福利厚生担当、加入者ポータル、福利厚生の相談窓口で、具体的な内容について質問できます。

segments.src: 7. **Think about alternatives.** If you have access to a spouse's plan or are eligible for other coverage, compare it with your own employer's options. Marketplace coverage may be an option in some situations, so review eligibility rules.
segments.tr: 7. **代替案を検討する。** 配偶者のプランを利用できる場合や、他の保険に加入できる場合は、雇用主のプランと比較してください。状況によっては公的マーケットプレイスの保険が選択肢になる場合もあるため、加入資格の規則を確認してください。

segments.src: 8. **Confirm your choices.** Save your confirmation and review your first paycheck to make sure the deductions match what you selected.
segments.tr: 8. **選択内容を確認する。** 確認の控えを保存し、最初の給与明細で天引きの内容が選択したものと一致しているか確かめてください。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: Rising health care and drug costs are shaping the benefits offered at many workplaces, and employees are often asked to cover more of the expense through premiums and deductibles.
segments.tr: 医療費と薬剤費の上昇は、多くの職場で提供される福利厚生の内容を形作っており、従業員は保険料と免責額を通じて、より多くの費用を負担するよう求められることが多くなっています。

segments.src: The best response is to compare plans on total expected cost and fit with your health needs, not just the monthly premium.
segments.tr: 最善の対応は、月額保険料だけでなく、想定される総費用と自分の健康ニーズへの適合性を基準にプランを比較することです。

segments.src: Taking an hour with your benefits materials now can help you avoid surprises later in the year.
segments.tr: 今のうちに福利厚生の資料に1時間ほど目を通しておけば、年の後半の予想外の出費を避ける助けになります。

segments.src: *Because plan rules, tax limits, and eligibility requirements change, verify the details with your employer, your plan administrator, and official sources such as the IRS and Healthcare.gov before making decisions.*
segments.tr: *プランの規則、税制上の上限、加入要件は変更されるため、判断を下す前に、雇用主、プランの管理者、そしてIRSやHealthcare.govなどの公式情報源で詳細を必ず確認してください。*

de.title: Krankenversicherung des Arbeitgebers 2027: Warum die Open-Enrollment-Phase oft höhere Prämien und größere Selbstbeteiligungen bedeutet

segments.src: As open enrollment season begins at many workplaces, a familiar pattern is showing up in benefits packets: the cost of coverage is rising, and more of that cost is landing on employees.
segments.tr: Während die Open-Enrollment-Phase an vielen Arbeitsplätzen beginnt, zeigt sich in den Leistungspaketen ein bekanntes Muster: Die Kosten für den Versicherungsschutz steigen, und ein größerer Teil dieser Kosten fällt bei den Beschäftigten an.

segments.src: Surveys from benefits consultants and industry groups have pointed to continued increases in medical and prescription drug spending, and many employers say they are adjusting plan designs to manage the bill.
segments.tr: Umfragen von Beratungsunternehmen für Leistungen und Branchenverbänden zeigen weiterhin steigende Ausgaben für medizinische Versorgung und verschreibungspflichtige Medikamente, und viele Arbeitgeber geben an, ihre Tarifgestaltung anzupassen, um die Kosten zu steuern.

segments.src: This guide explains why premiums and deductibles tend to climb, what to compare when you review your options for 2027, and how to avoid common mistakes before your enrollment window closes.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden erklärt, warum Prämien und Selbstbeteiligungen tendenziell steigen, worauf Sie bei der Prüfung Ihrer Optionen für 2027 achten sollten und wie Sie häufige Fehler vermeiden, bevor das Einschreibefenster schließt.

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is for general information only. It is not medical, tax, legal, or financial advice. Plan details vary widely, so always check your own employer's official materials.
segments.tr: > **Hinweis:** Dieser Artikel dient nur allgemeinen Informationszwecken. Er stellt keine medizinische, steuerliche, rechtliche oder finanzielle Beratung dar. Die Planeinzelheiten unterscheiden sich stark, prüfen Sie daher immer die offiziellen Unterlagen Ihres Arbeitgebers.

segments.src: ## Why Costs Keep Rising
segments.tr: ## Warum die Kosten weiter steigen

segments.src: Several forces tend to push employer plan costs up at the same time:
segments.tr: Mehrere Faktoren treiben die Kosten von Arbeitgeberplänen gleichzeitig nach oben:

segments.src: - **Higher medical prices and use of care.** Hospital and provider costs, along with greater use of services, can raise what a plan pays out.
segments.tr: - **Höhere Medizinpreise und Inanspruchnahme.** Kosten von Krankenhäusern und Leistungserbringern sowie eine stärkere Inanspruchnahme von Leistungen können erhöhen, was der Plan auszahlt.

segments.src: - **Prescription drug spending.** Specialty medications and newer, high-cost therapies are a growing share of claims for many plans.
segments.tr: - **Ausgaben für verschreibungspflichtige Medikamente.** Spezialmedikamente und neuere, teure Therapien machen bei vielen Plänen einen wachsenden Anteil der Ansprüche aus.

segments.src: - **Plan renewals and insurer pricing.** Insurers and stop-loss carriers reset rates each year, and employers that self-fund their plans carry the risk of large claims directly.
segments.tr: - **Vertragsverlängerungen und Preisgestaltung der Versicherer.** Versicherer und Stop-Loss-Träger setzen die Tarife jedes Jahr neu fest, und Arbeitgeber mit selbstfinanzierten Plänen tragen das Risiko großer Schäden direkt.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing shifts.** To hold down their own spending, employers may raise employee premium contributions, deductibles, copays, or out-of-pocket maximums, or they may narrow provider networks.
segments.tr: - **Verlagerung der Kostenbeteiligung.** Um ihre eigenen Ausgaben zu begrenzen, erhöhen Arbeitgeber womöglich die Prämienanteile der Beschäftigten, Selbstbeteiligungen, Zuzahlungen oder Höchstbeträge für Eigenanteile, oder sie verengen die Netzwerke der Leistungserbringer.

segments.src: The result is that a plan that looked familiar last year may cost more or work differently this year, even if the plan name has not changed.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis: Ein Plan, der im Vorjahr vertraut war, kann in diesem Jahr mehr kosten oder anders funktionieren, selbst wenn der Plan-Name unverändert geblieben ist.

segments.src: ## What Changes You May See
segments.tr: ## Welche Änderungen Sie erwarten können

segments.src: Not every employer makes the same moves, but common adjustments include:
segments.tr: Nicht jeder Arbeitgeber trifft dieselben Maßnahmen, aber übliche Anpassungen sind:

segments.src: 1. **Higher payroll deductions.** Your per-paycheck premium may rise, and the increase is often larger for family coverage.
segments.tr: 1. **Höhere Gehaltsabzüge.** Ihre Prämie pro Gehaltszahlung kann steigen, und der Anstieg fällt bei Familienversicherungen oft größer aus.

segments.src: 2. **Bigger deductibles.** You may have to pay more out of pocket before the plan starts sharing costs.
segments.tr: 2. **Größere Selbstbeteiligungen.** Sie müssen möglicherweise mehr aus eigener Tasche zahlen, bevor der Plan sich an den Kosten beteiligt.

segments.src: 3. **Higher out-of-pocket maximums.** This is the most you could pay in a plan year for covered, in-network care.
segments.tr: 3. **Höhere Höchstbeträge für Eigenanteile.** Dies ist der höchste Betrag, den Sie in einem Planjahr für abgedeckte Leistungen innerhalb des Netzwerks zahlen müssten.

segments.src: 4. **Changes to drug coverage.** Look for tier changes, new prior-authorization rules, or different copays and coinsurance.
segments.tr: 4. **Änderungen bei der Arzneimittelabdeckung.** Achten Sie auf Änderungen der Tarifstufen, neue Regeln zur vorherigen Genehmigung (Prior Authorization) oder abweichende Zuzahlungen und Kostenbeteiligungen.

segments.src: 5. **Network changes.** A doctor or hospital you use may move in or out of the network.
segments.tr: 5. **Netzwerkänderungen.** Ein Arzt oder ein Krankenhaus, das Sie nutzen, kann ins Netzwerk aufgenommen werden oder es verlassen.

segments.src: 6. **Fewer plan choices.** Some employers consolidate options or steer people toward high-deductible plans.
segments.tr: 6. **Weniger Tarifwahlmöglichkeiten.** Manche Arbeitgeber fassen Optionen zusammen oder lenken Personen zu Plänen mit hoher Selbstbeteiligung.

segments.src: ## What to Compare Side by Side
segments.tr: ## Was Sie Seite an Seite vergleichen sollten

segments.tr: Beurteilen Sie einen Plan nicht allein nach der Prämie.

segments.tr: Erstellen Sie für jede Option einen einfachen Vergleich:

segments.tr: | Prämie pro Gehaltszahlung | Ihre garantierten Jahreskosten, unabhängig davon, ob Sie Leistungen in Anspruch nehmen |

segments.src: | Deductible (individual and family) | What you pay before most cost-sharing begins |
segments.tr: | Selbstbeteiligung (einzeln und Familie) | Was Sie zahlen, bevor der größte Teil der Kostenbeteiligung beginnt |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case spending for covered in-network care |
segments.tr: | Höchstbetrag für Eigenanteile | Ihr schlimmstmöglicher Aufwand für abgedeckte Leistungen im Netzwerk |

segments.tr: | Zuzahlungen und Kostenbeteiligung | Was Sie für Besuche, Untersuchungen und Eingriffe zahlen |

segments.tr: | Arzneimittel-Tarifstufen | Ob Ihre regelmäßigen Medikamente abgedeckt sind und zu welchen Kosten |

segments.tr: | Netzwerk | Ob Ihre Ärzte, Fachärzte und Ihr Krankenhaus im Netzwerk sind |
